translation.绝对值不超过 Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER、小数最多15位；超: Absolute values stay within Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and decimals use at most 15 places; values beyond either limit prompt users to use TextField.

translation.受控数值；绝对值不得超过 Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER，小数最: Controlled value; its absolute value must not exceed Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, and it may have at most 15 decimal places. Pair it with onChange to update the value.
translation.非受控初始值；超出安全范围或精度时显示错误并阻止提交。: Initial uncontrolled value; values beyond the safe range or precision limit show an error and are not committed.
translation.设置允许的最小值；组件输入值仍遵守 JavaScript 安全范围和精度上限。: Sets the minimum; entered values still follow the JavaScript safe-range and precision limits.
translation.设置允许的最大值；组件输入值仍遵守 JavaScript 安全范围和精度上限。: Sets the maximum; entered values still follow the JavaScript safe-range and precision limits.
translation.加减按钮、键盘和滚轮每次变更的步长；不安全步长回退为 1。: Step applied by the increment/decrement buttons, arrow keys and wheel; an unsafe step falls back to 1.
translation.限制允许输入的小数位数，最高为15位；未配置时也最多允许15位。还会校验转换为: Limits fractional digits to at most 15, including when this prop is omitted. It also checks whether conversion to JavaScript Number would round the value; a larger integer part may leave fewer safe decimal places. Unsafe input prompts users to use TextField.
translation.把安全范围内的内部值转换为输入框展示文本。: Formats an internal value within the safe range for display.
translation.把输入文本转换为提交值；解析结果仍受最大安全数值和15位小数限制。: Converts input text to a value; parsed results still follow the maximum safe value and 15-place precision limits.
translation.以字符串回调数值；仅改变返回类型，不放宽 JavaScript 安全范围或小数精: Returns values as strings. This changes only the callback type and does not expand the JavaScript safe range or precision limit.
translation.日期、快捷项、时间和清除值每次变化时立即回调；面板不会因选择动作自动关闭。: Changes to dates, presets, time fields and cleared values call onChange immediately; selection does not close the panel.

translation.起止日期每次变化时立即回调，包括仅选择开始日期时的未完成范围。: Reports every range-date change immediately, including an incomplete range after choosing only the start date.
translation.true 时显示确定按钮；范围值仍即时回传，点击确定只关闭面板。: Shows a Confirm button when true; range values still update immediately, and Confirm only closes the panel.
translation.覆盖左侧快捷范围列表；选中后立即回传并聚焦到范围结束日期所在月份。: Replaces the preset list; selecting a preset updates the value immediately and focuses the month containing the range end.
translation.时间列、快捷项和清除值每次变化时立即回调；面板保持打开。: Reports time-field, preset and clear changes immediately while keeping the panel open.
translation.true 时显示确定按钮；时间值仍即时回传，点击确定只关闭面板。: Shows a Confirm button when true; time values still update immediately, and Confirm only closes the panel.
translation.起止时间每次变化时立即回调；面板保持打开。: Reports every time-range change immediately while keeping the panel open.
translation.true 时显示确定按钮；时间范围仍即时回传，点击确定只关闭面板。: Shows a Confirm button when true; time-range values still update immediately, and Confirm only closes the panel.
translation.选择后立即回传并保持面板打开；日期日历同步聚焦到目标月份，范围优先聚焦结束日期。: Selecting a preset updates the value immediately and keeps the panel open; date calendars focus its target month, and range calendars prioritize the end date.
translation.显示确定按钮；选择仍即时触发 onChange，点击确定只关闭面板。: Shows a Confirm button; selection still calls onChange immediately, and Confirm only closes the panel.
translation.快捷项选择后立即回传并切换日历月份；范围日历以结束日期所在月份为焦点。: Selecting a preset updates the value and calendar month immediately; range calendars focus the month containing the end date.
translation.日期、时间、快捷项和清除均即时回传，选择后保持打开；快捷日期会同步跳转日历视图，: Date, time, preset and clear changes are reported immediately while the panel stays open; calendar shortcuts also navigate to the selected month, and Confirm only closes the panel.
translation.日期、时间、快捷项和清除均即时回传，选择后保持打开；可直接输入年份、选择月份，并: Date, time, preset and clear changes are reported immediately while the panel stays open. Enter a year or select a month directly; the demo includes a 12-hour date-time example.
translation.同时展示 24 小时制和 12 小时制；时间变化即时回传并保持面板打开，确认按钮: Shows both 24-hour and 12-hour time formats. Time changes are reported immediately while the panel stays open; Confirm only closes it.

translation.桌面悬浮或键盘聚焦时展示；触屏设备长按后显示说明。: Shown on hover or keyboard focus on desktop; touch users can long-press for help.

translation.批量确认可异步校验；返回 false 保留草稿，异常显示可重试提示。: Validate batch edits asynchronously; false retains the draft, while errors display a retry hint.

translation.按换行和回车切分，去掉首尾空白与空项；可分别开启空白分隔和中英文逗号分隔，保留顺: Splits on line breaks and carriage returns, trims items and removes empty items; optional whitespace and comma separators preserve order and duplicates.
translation.控制自动轨道的最小宽度；最多六列，非法值回退 170，操作区保留最后一个显式轨道: Sets the minimum automatic track width, up to six columns; invalid values fall back to 170. Actions occupy the last explicit track.
translation.PageFilter.Item 字段；主区域按容器宽度计算等分 Grid 列数，: PageFilter.Item fields share equal explicit grid tracks with actions. Fields beyond maxRows move into a Drawer using the same controlled state.
translation.列宽手柄全部关闭；前 3 条记录可用指针调整行高，范围为 40 - 88px，也: Column handles are off. Use the pointer to resize the first three rows from 40–88px, or focus a handle and use the arrow keys, Home or End.
translation.启用行底部行高调整手柄；可按记录限制，并支持指针拖动和键盘方向键、Home/En: Enables row-height handles at row boundaries, can be limited by record, and supports pointer and arrow/Home/End keyboard resizing.
translation.fillRemainingSpace=false：按精确内容总宽独立调整；本例操: fillRemainingSpace=false: preserve exact content width and resize columns independently. In this example, the action column follows table content order; fixed-column behavior is shown separately.
translation.调整最近更新列后改变窗口宽度：动态列保留提交宽度，视口余量由表格填充槽承接；之后: Resize the Last updated column, then change the viewport: its committed width stays fixed and the table spacer absorbs viewport surplus. Later resizes of other columns are still balanced through the same dynamic leaf.
translation.控制是否填充剩余空间；true 使用一个稳定动态普通列（显式 elasticCo: Controls remaining-space fill. With true, one stable dynamic ordinary leaf is used (elasticColumn, or the final visible ordinary leaf when omitted). Resizing another ordinary leaf uses that dynamic leaf as the only balance point and progresses from its current committed width. Directly resizing the dynamic leaf uses the nearest preceding ordinary leaf to compensate from its inner edge. Once that neighbor reaches a bound, any remaining change is handled by the table spacer or content overflow; fixed, action and auxiliary columns stay isolated. False keeps exact content width and resizes independently.
translation.直接拖动时目标列遵守此最小宽度；动态列达到下限后，表格现有填充槽可继续吸收变化。: Direct resize targets stop at this minimum; when the dynamic column reaches it, an existing table spacer may absorb further changes.
translation.直接拖动目标列的最大像素宽度；动态列参与自动填充或其他列的平衡补偿时可以超过此值: Maximum pixel width for a direct drag; the designated dynamic column can exceed it during automatic fill or balancing.
translation.指定稳定承担余量的普通列；省略时默认最后一个可见普通叶子列。拖动其他普通列时，以: Selects the stable ordinary leaf that absorbs viewport surplus; the final visible ordinary leaf is used when omitted. Resizing another ordinary leaf uses it as the only balance point and progresses from its current width. Dragging the dynamic leaf itself uses the nearest preceding ordinary leaf as compensation from the inner-edge handle. Once that neighbor reaches a bound, the table spacer or content overflow handles any remaining change. False or scroll.x=max-content uses exact content width and independent resizing.
translation.使用统一操作列宽度：桌面为 180px，视口小于 500px 时为 60px；操: Action columns use 180px on desktop and 60px below a 500px viewport. They never absorb spare width or compensate for other column resizes.
translation.在表头标题旁显示说明图标，通过公共 Tooltip 展示内容并与标题垂直居中。: Displays a help icon beside the header title using the shared Tooltip, centered vertically with the title.
translation.固定列隔离与多级表头: Fixed column isolation and grouped headers
translation.名称和操作列保持固定宽度，选择与展开列也不参与补偿；拖动普通列或末列验证边界。: Name, actions, selection and expansion widths remain protected. Resize ordinary and last columns to verify the bounds.
translation.固定列不会被普通列拖动或自动填充改变宽度。: Ordinary column resizes and automatic filling never change fixed column widths.
translation.是否把主区可见字段也放入 Drawer；设为 false 时仅展示已折叠字段及: Includes visible inline fields in the Drawer; false shows only collapsed fields and moreFields, all sharing the same controlled state.
translation.折叠时主筛选区行数上限，有限值归一化到 1..2；autoCollapse=fa: Limits collapsed inline rows to a normalized value of 1..2; autoCollapse=false lets fields expand into additional natural rows.
translation.按字段数量、容器和动作宽度判断溢出并提供 Drawer；false 时完整展开，: Detects overflow from field count, container and action widths and provides a Drawer; false shows all fields, and widening the window never unmounts an open Drawer.
translation.fillRemainingSpace=true：拖动动态列时由其前一普通列反向补: fillRemainingSpace=true: dragging the dynamic column is compensated in the opposite direction by the nearest preceding ordinary column. Resizing another ordinary column is absorbed by that same dynamic column. Once a compensation column reaches a bound, the table spacer or content overflow handles the remaining width; fixed, action and auxiliary columns remain isolated.
translation.在浮动 label 文本后显示说明图标；文本 span、Tooltip 包装和: Shows a help icon after the floating label. The text span, Tooltip wrappers and SVG share the same vertical center; hover or focus reveals the hint.
translation.追加到 item 根 div 节点，保留 biu-pro-page-filter: Appends a class to the root item div and retains the biu-pro-page-filter__item class.
translation.设置主输入错误状态；批量提交失败保留独立重试提示。: Sets the main input error state; failed batch submissions retain a separate retry message.
translation.显示加载并禁止输入、清空和打开批量编辑。: Shows loading and blocks typing, clearing and opening batch editing.
translation.清空已提交值时回调；草稿内清空需应用后才提交。: Runs when the committed value is cleared. Clearing a draft commits only after Apply.
translation.显示主输入字符计数；编辑浮层另外显示解析后的项数。: Shows the main input character count. The editor separately shows the parsed item count.
translation.在主输入左侧显示前置内容。: Shows leading content before the main input.
translation.在主输入右侧显示自定义内容，并与批量入口组合。: Shows custom trailing content beside the batch entry.
translation.透传主输入属性；顶层值缺省时使用其 value/defaultValue，批量草: Forwards main input attributes. value/defaultValue provide fallbacks when top-level values are omitted; ProTextField still owns batch drafts.
translation.追加到 ProTextField 根节点；PageFilter.Item 自动追: Appends a class to the ProTextField root. PageFilter.Item automatically adds w-full.
translation.禁止输入、清空及批量编辑，并关闭已打开的编辑浮层。: Blocks typing, clearing and batch editing, and closes an open editor.
translation.保留文本可读，禁止输入、清空及批量编辑。: Keeps text readable while blocking typing, clearing and batch editing.
translation.主输入占位文案；草稿占位由 textareaProps.placeholder: Main input placeholder. textareaProps.placeholder overrides the draft placeholder.
translation.限制主输入长度，草稿默认继承，可由 textareaProps.maxLengt: Limits the main input length. Drafts inherit the limit unless textareaProps.maxLength overrides it.
translation.主输入粘贴前回调；preventDefault 可阻止多行粘贴自动打开草稿。: Runs before main input paste processing. preventDefault blocks automatic draft opening for multiline paste.
translation.主输入按键回调，Enter 可打开多行汇总；草稿内 Ctrl/Command+E: Main input keyboard callback. Enter opens a multiline summary; Ctrl/Command+Enter applies an editor draft.
translation.主输入点击回调；未 preventDefault 时点击多行汇总打开原文编辑。: Main input click callback. Clicking a multiline summary opens raw-text editing unless preventDefault is called.
translation.观察主输入原生 input 事件；值同步使用 onChange(value, i: Observes native main input events. Synchronize values through onChange(value, items).
translation.转发到主输入，支持聚焦和读取选择范围。: Forwarded to the main input for focus and selection access.
translation.仅解析输入，不修改原文；空字符串、纯空白和运行时非字符串值返回空列表。: Parses without modifying the source. Empty, whitespace-only and runtime non-string input returns an empty list.
translation.开启后所有空白字符参与分隔，默认保留词组内部空格。: Includes every whitespace character in separators when enabled; phrases retain internal spaces by default.
translation.独立开启中英文逗号分隔，可与空白分隔组合。: Independently enables Chinese and English comma separators and can be combined with whitespace splitting.
translation.只为显式开启的叶子列显示手柄；fixed 列通过面向普通列的内边调整自身，其他列: Only explicitly resizable leaf columns show a handle. Fixed columns resize themselves from the inner edge facing ordinary columns; resizing other columns and filling remaining space do not change their width.
translation.固定右侧操作列已开启独立调整：拖动靠近普通列的左侧内边，宽度范围为 80–260: The fixed-right action column supports independent resizing from its left inner edge, facing ordinary columns, within 80–260px. Resizing other columns and automatic fill do not change its width.
translation.固定列只有显式 resizable=true 时可以直接调整自身宽度；左右固定列: A fixed column can resize itself only when resizable=true is explicitly set. Both fixed sides use their inner edge facing ordinary columns.
translation.普通输入即时回传原文及解析列表；失焦时按已开启分隔符拆分并格式化；批量应用回传换: Direct typing reports raw text and parsed items. Blur splits and formats enabled separators; batch Apply reports newline-normalized text.
translation.主输入失焦先通知调用方，再按已开启分隔符拆分并格式化；文本变化时通过 onCha: Calls blur handlers first, then splits and formats enabled separators; changed text is reported through onChange(value, items).
translation.显示24px批量编辑入口，可在浮层中粘贴多行文本。: Shows a 24px batch editor entry for pasting multiline text into the popover.
translation.显示24px批量编辑入口，可在浮层中粘贴多行文本；关闭入口后，失焦分隔仍生效。: Shows the 24px batch editor entry for multiline paste; blur splitting stays enabled if the entry is hidden.
translation.页码、页大小、快速跳转、总数、三档响应式布局和简洁模式。: Page navigation, page size, quick jump, totals, three responsive layouts, and simple mode.
translation.自定义页码、总数、页大小选项和三档响应式布局。: Custom page items, totals, page-size options, and three responsive layouts.
translation.同时设置页大小下拉和快速跳转输入框宽度；默认 90px。responsive 小: Sets the page-size select and quick-jump input width together; defaults to 90px. With responsive enabled, both use 45px below 800px. Below 560px only the current page is shown; from 560–799px the full page list remains while range/total text is hidden; at 800px and wider this configured width is used.
translation.小于 560px 时只显示当前页；560–799px 保留完整页码但隐藏范围/总: Below 560px, show only the current page. From 560–799px, keep the full page list and hide range/total text. At 800px and wider, use the standard layout. Page-size and quick-jump controls are 45px below 800px.
translation.支持数字像素值或 CSS 宽度字符串；同时设置 Table 分页的页大小下拉和跳: Accepts a pixel number or CSS width string and sets the Table page-size select and quick-jump input widths together. Defaults to 90px; responsive layouts use 45px below 800px.
translation.响应式分为三档：小于 560px 显示当前页，560–799px 隐藏范围/总数: Responsive behavior has three bands: below 560px, show only the current page; from 560–799px, hide range/total text and keep the full page list; at 800px and wider, use the standard layout. The page-size and quick-jump controls are 45px in the first two bands.
translation.标记操作列；列不参与余量分配或其他列的拖动补偿。宽度按表格可用宽度响应式设置为: Marks an action column excluded from remaining-space distribution and resize compensation. Its width follows the available table width: 60/160/190px below 560px, from 560–799px, and at 800px or wider. The default ButtonList maxCount is 1/3/5 across those bands, including the overflow button. Explicit column widths and ButtonList limits take precedence; resizing still requires resizable.
translation.最多可见槽位，包含 ellipsis 溢出按钮；达到上限时最后一格自动作为 Dr: Maximum visible slots including the ellipsis overflow button; the last slot becomes a DropdownMenu when the limit is reached. An explicit maxCount applies at every viewport.
translation.指定 800px 以下的可见槽位上限，优先于 maxCount 和响应式默认；未: Sets the visible-slot limit below 800px, taking precedence over maxCount and responsive defaults. Without explicit limits, standalone lists default to 3 slots below 800px and 1 below 560px; action columns receive their responsive default from Table.
translation.数值绝对值不超过 Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER（9007199: Absolute values are limited to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (9007199254740991), with at most 15 decimal places. Input that rounds during conversion to JavaScript Number is rejected; larger integer portions may leave fewer safe decimal places. Unsafe input keeps the last valid value and prompts users to use TextField. stringMode follows the same limits.
translation.显示外部校验错误并切换错误样式。: Displays an external validation error and switches to the error style.
translation.禁用输入框和增减按钮。: Disables the input and increment/decrement buttons.
translation.保留值供查看，但禁止输入和步进。: Keeps the value readable while blocking typing and stepping.
translation.追加到组件根节点。: Adds a class to the component root.
translation.仅安全有效的数值会触发；超出范围或精度时保留原有效值并提示改用文本输入框。: Only safe, valid values trigger this callback; out-of-range or imprecise drafts keep the last valid value and prompt users to switch to TextField.
translation.root | control | input | decrement | inc: root | control | input | decrement | increment | error, and other slots
translation.文案 key-value 对象: A key-value map of text overrides
translation.验证 LayoutFrame、Runtime 上下文、偏好控制和基座交互组件。: Explore LayoutFrame, Runtime context, preference controls and platform interactions.
translation.页面级覆盖会在导航离开前由 Runtime 自动清理。: Runtime clears page-level overrides before navigating away.
translation.Dialog 与 Drawer 使用 Components Pro 入口，业务内: Dialog and Drawer use the Components Pro entry. The page supplies their business content.
translation.按完整菜单导航到 Dashboard: Navigate to Dashboard by full menu key
translation.已按完整菜单 key 导航到 Dashboard：{key}: Navigated to Dashboard by full menu key: {key}
translation.事件总线、导航和布局由 Runtime 提供。: Runtime provides the event bus, navigation and layout controls.
translation.遮罩、Escape、焦点恢复和关闭原因由 Components 统一维护。: Components manage the backdrop, Escape key, focus restoration and close reasons.
translation.基座只提供布局与生命周期，Drawer 内容由当前页面提供。: The platform provides layout and lifecycle controls. This page supplies the Drawer content.
translation.Form / ProForm 本区域 API: Form / ProForm API for this region
translation.Form 基于 react-hook-form，Item 只管理字段状态和校验，: Form uses react-hook-form. Item manages field state and validation, while render props render the application controls.
translation.Form.Item / Field 本区域 API: Form.Item / Field API for this region
translation.Form.Item 不克隆输入组件，错误状态通过 render props 显式: Form.Item passes error state explicitly through render props without cloning input components.
translation.Form.List columns 以动态表格方式组织一行多个字段。: Form.List columns arrange multiple fields per row in a dynamic table.
translation.FormGroup / Form.Group 本区域 API: FormGroup / Form.Group API for this region
translation.ProTable / ButtonList 区域 API: ProTable / ButtonList API for this region
translation.Slider 通过 Form.Item 受控写入单值和范围值；表单提交时得到可直: Slider writes controlled single values and ranges through Form.Item. Submitted values are numbers ready for the backend.
translation.Table / Column / Pagination 区域 API: Table / Column / Pagination API for this region
translation.TextField 的输入过滤和 InputNumber 的展示格式都由控件处理: TextField handles input filtering and InputNumber handles display formatting. Each example shows both the displayed content and the actual Form value.
translation.footer 由调用方自定义，不混入 Toolbar 或 Pagination。: The caller defines the footer independently of Toolbar and Pagination.
translation.striped 默认关闭；打开后偶数行使用比 hover 更浅的灰色底色，适合快: striped is off by default. When enabled, even rows use a gray background lighter than hover, making long lists easier to scan.
translation.useQueryTable 查询区域 API: useQueryTable API for this query region
translation.一个完整页面同时展示筛选区、工具栏、Table/ProTable 组合、列设置显: This complete page demonstrates filters, a toolbar, Table/ProTable, column visibility and ordering, collapsed row actions, and separate pagination. Each region is followed by its API table.
translation.三个控件共同维护一个 cardNumber 字段，提交时作为一个完整值传给后端。: Three controls share one cardNumber field, submitted to the backend as a complete value.
translation.以 10 为步进调整屏幕亮度。: Adjust screen brightness in steps of 10.
translation.偶数行浅灰，鼠标经过时统一切换为 hover 背景。: Even rows are light gray; hovering uses the same hover background on every row.
translation.前缀来自枚举，中间为三位数字，末段只允许英文字符。: Choose an enumerated prefix, enter three digits, and finish with English letters.
translation.卡号格式应为 4 位枚举-3 位数字-4 位英文: Use a 4-digit prefix, 3 digits, and 4 English letters separated by hyphens
translation.参数、排序、筛选或分页变化时会取消旧请求；组件卸载时也会释放 AbortCont: Changes to parameters, sorting, filters, or pagination cancel the previous request. Unmounting also releases the AbortController.
translation.双击单元格进入编辑，使用公共控件完成文本、下拉、数字、文本域、日期和时间编辑；E: Double-click a cell to edit text, selections, numbers, multiline text, dates, or times with shared controls. Enter or blur saves; Esc exits editing.
translation.只允许大写字母、数字和短横线: Only uppercase letters, digits, and hyphens are allowed
translation.只允许字母和数字: Only letters and digits are allowed
translation.同一套 PageFilter 会根据字段数量呈现单行、两行和超出两行自动收敛到更: PageFilter adapts to one or two rows and moves overflow fields into more filters. Actions stay aligned as a sibling item.
translation.姓名支持异步校验；开启审批后会动态增加必填字段，Form 不克隆业务控件。: The name supports asynchronous validation. Enabling approval adds a required field dynamically; Form does not clone application controls.
translation.字段可嵌套、可禁用并保持显式控件绑定。: Fields support nesting and disabling with explicit control bindings.
translation.展示值带千分位，实际值保持可提交的数字。: The display includes thousands separators; the actual value stays a number ready to submit.
translation.拖动列宽或行高后查看回调: Resize a column or row to see its callback
translation.按能力当前状态筛选结果。: Filter results by the current capability status.
translation.支持按能力名称或负责人搜索。: Search by capability name or owner.
translation.日期、时间和区间控件使用同一套受控字段协议。: Date, time, and range controls use the same controlled field contract.
translation.查询状态、取消、重试和响应归一化都在同一个 Table 能力页中展示。: Query state, cancellation, retry, and response normalization are demonstrated on the same Table capability page.
translation.根据表单状态动态展示审批字段，并保持字段联动。: Show approval fields dynamically from form state while preserving field dependencies.
translation.用于展示字段标签后的帮助说明。: Shows help text after the field label.
translation.统一展示 Table、ProTable、useQueryTable 的使用方式、: Explore Table, ProTable, and useQueryTable usage, interactions, and public properties. Filters, toolbar, table, and pagination follow the standard CRUD page layout.
translation.维护该能力的功能团队。: The functional team maintaining this capability.
translation.联系人的显示名称或工作账号。: The contact's display name or work account.
translation.能力在组件库中的公开名称。: The capability's public name in the component library.
translation.请先修正以下字段: Please correct the following fields first
translation.请求函数可接入任意 HTTP 客户端，Table 只消费统一的 tablePro: The request function can use any HTTP client; Table consumes the unified tableProps.
translation.请输入可接收通知的邮箱地址。: Enter an email address that can receive notifications.
translation.独立演示尺寸调整能力：只有配置 resizable 的列显示列宽手柄，开启 ro: This example demonstrates resizing. Only resizable columns show handles; rowResizable enables dragging row separators. Changes commit after dragging, and the density menu can restore default sizes.
translation.已恢复列宽、行高和密度默认值: Default column widths, row heights, and density restored
translation.这是一条简约单行消息: This is a simple single-line message
translation.第一行简约说明\n第二行补充当前状态和下一步处理建议。:
Simple explanation on the first line
The second line describes the current status and suggested next step.
translation.第一行复杂错误说明\n第二行说明处理建议，右侧关闭按钮不会覆盖正文。:
Detailed error explanation on the first line
The second line suggests a solution; the close button does not cover the message.
translation.Form.Grid / Form.Section 本区域 API: Form.Grid / Form.Section API for this region
translation.Drawer 打开或关闭后回调；取消、确定、关闭图标和遮罩关闭都会进入同一状态通: Called after Drawer opens or closes; cancel, confirm, the close icon, and the overlay all use the same state channel.
translation.boolean 启用排序；函数为客户端比较器。: A boolean enables sorting; a function provides a client-side comparator.
translation.columns 模式是否允许拖动整行排序；排序结果由 Form.List 内部维: Allows dragging entire rows to reorder them in columns mode; Form.List maintains the order internally and exposes it through operations.move.
translation.columns 模式每行删除按钮的文案或自定义节点。: Text or a custom node for each row's remove button in columns mode.
translation.columns 模式点击默认新增按钮时追加的行值；未传时追加空对象，render: The row value appended by the default add button in columns mode; defaults to an empty object. In render props mode, operations.add(value) still accepts a custom value.
translation.columns 模式默认新增按钮的文案或自定义节点。: Text or a custom node for the default add button in columns mode.
translation.false 时不发起请求并将 loading/isFetching 置为 fal: When false, no request is made and loading/isFetching are set to false.
translation.form.reset() 执行后触发的回调，适合同步页面外部查询参数或提示。: Called after form.reset(); use it to synchronize external query parameters or display feedback.
translation.params 变化时将 current 重置为 1。: Resets current to 1 when params change.
translation.query.status 的标准状态值。: The standard status values of query.status.
translation.queryFn 收到的分页状态和 hook 对外暴露的当前分页。: The pagination state received by queryFn and the current pagination exposed by the hook.
translation.render props 返回稳定 key 的 fields、add/remov: The render props expose fields with stable keys, add/remove/move/replace operations, and errors metadata.
translation.render 的显式别名，优先级高于 render，便于表达单元格渲染。: An explicit alias for render that takes precedence over render and clarifies cell rendering.
translation.required: 请填写该字段: required: Please fill in this field
translation.select 类型的选项列表；选择先写入编辑草稿，由保存按钮或失焦提交。: Options for the select editor; selection updates the editing draft and is committed by the save button or on blur.
translation.tbody 区域类名。: Class name for the tbody region.
translation.true 使用一个稳定动态普通列；拖动动态列时由前一普通列反向补偿，拖动其他普通: true uses one stable dynamic ordinary column. Resizing that column is balanced inversely by the preceding ordinary column; resizing other ordinary columns makes the dynamic column compensate incrementally from its current width without jumping back to its maximum. fixed, action, and auxiliary columns do not participate. false uses the exact total content width and adjusts columns independently.
translation.useFieldArray 的数组字段路径；字段名通过 fields 的 nam: The array field path for useFieldArray; names for Form.Item are assembled from the name/index of each entry in fields.
translation.上一页按钮的文案或图标。: Text or an icon for the previous-page button.
translation.上移/下移排序: Reorder with move up / move down
translation.下一页按钮的文案或图标。: Text or an icon for the next-page button.
translation.为 false 时字段卸载后注销 Controller；为 true 时保留字段: false unregisters the Controller when the field unmounts; true preserves its value for business sections that can be toggled.
translation.为 root、item、label、control、help、descripti: Adds stable class names to root, item, label, control, help, description, message, and other regions.
translation.为展开内容行追加类名。: Adds a class name to expanded-content rows.
translation.为数据行追加类名；可根据记录返回不同状态类。: Adds a class name to data rows; a function can return different state classes for each record.
translation.为每行追加原生属性和事件，不替换 Table 的行状态。: Adds native attributes and events to each row without replacing Table's row state.
translation.为选择、展开和分页提供稳定行键；未传时使用数据源索引。: Provides stable row keys for selection, expansion, and pagination; defaults to the data-source index.
translation.仅在表格默认操作列等明确场景设为 true；可见动作变为方形 icon-only: Set true only for explicit cases such as the default table action column. Visible actions become square icon-only buttons with Tooltip; custom Toolbar actions retain icons and text by default.
translation.从记录读取单元格值的路径；不传时可完全使用 render/renderCell。: The path used to read a cell value from a record; omit it to render entirely through render/renderCell.
translation.任意请求进行中为 true，包括保留上一页数据的后台刷新；请求结束或取消后为 f: true while any request is in progress, including background refreshes that retain the previous page's data; false after completion or cancellation.
translation.传递数组级校验规则给 react-hook-form useFieldArray: Passes array-level validation rules to react-hook-form useFieldArray.
translation.传递给 Controller 的 react-hook-form 校验规则，支持: react-hook-form validation rules passed to Controller, including required, pattern, min, and validate.
translation.作为占位参照的非 fixed 列键；拖动时由当前指针所在 item 提供。: The non-fixed column key used as a placeholder reference; provided by the item currently under the pointer during dragging.
translation.使用 error 语义色渲染危险操作。: Renders destructive actions using the error semantic color.
translation.使用 localStorage 持久化列可见性和顺序；存储失败不会阻断表格。: Persists column visibility and order in localStorage; storage failures do not interrupt the table.
translation.使用 localStorage 持久化列显示和排序；存储失败不会阻断表格。: Persists column visibility and ordering in localStorage; storage failures do not interrupt the table.
translation.保持当前列单行显示；未配置 width 时允许标准 table 根据内容扩展列宽: Keeps cells in this column on one line; without a configured width, a standard table may expand the column to fit its content. Otherwise, cells wrap by default and increase the row height.
translation.保留字段注册和当前值，但隐藏 Item 的可见布局。: Preserves field registration and the current value while hiding the Item's visible layout.
translation.允许一次选择多个 filters；多选值通过数组传递。: Allows selecting multiple filters; selected values are passed as an array.
translation.允许拖动该列表头分隔线调整宽度；未开启时不显示拖动手柄。: Allows dragging this column's header divider to resize it; no drag handle is shown unless enabled.
translation.允许的最多行数，范围 0..99999；达到上限时内置新增动作自动禁用。: Maximum row count, in the range 0..99999; the built-in add action is disabled at the limit.
translation.允许的最少行数，范围 0..99999；达到下限时内置删除动作自动禁用。: Minimum row count, in the range 0..99999; the built-in remove action is disabled at the limit.
translation.全屏切换后的受控状态回调。: Controlled-state callback after fullscreen is toggled.
translation.全选/取消全选后返回当前页和变化行。: Returns current-page rows and changed rows after selecting or deselecting all.
translation.关闭分页或传入受控分页配置；客户端数据会按 current/pageSize 截: Disables pagination or accepts controlled pagination settings; client-side data is sliced by current/pageSize.
translation.关闭面板但不改变已应用筛选值。: Closes the panel without changing the applied filter values.
translation.内置/自定义筛选应用或清除后返回完整筛选对象。: Returns the complete filter object when built-in or custom filters are applied or cleared.
translation.内置拖动或上移/下移完成后返回源行和目标行索引；列表值仍由 Form.List: Returns source and destination row indices after a built-in drag or move-up/move-down action; Form.List still synchronizes list values internally.
translation.决定 queryFn context.queryKey 是否追加 current: Determines whether current/pageSize are appended to queryFn context.queryKey.
translation.决定 sourceKey 插入 targetKey 前还是后；列设置面板用该值绘: Determines whether sourceKey is inserted before or after targetKey; the column-settings panel uses this to draw the corresponding dashed placeholder.
translation.减少中间页码数量，保留首尾和当前附近页。: Reduces intermediate page buttons while retaining the first, last, and nearby pages.
translation.分别定制 Item、label、control、help 插槽，保留 biu-f: Customizes the Item, label, control, and help slots individually while retaining the biu-form-item class prefix.
translation.分别定制 root 和 field 插槽类名，不改变 useFieldArray: Customizes root and field slot classes individually without changing useFieldArray state.
translation.分别定制 root、header、icon、title、description、: Customizes the root, header, icon, title, description, and body slots individually.
translation.分别覆盖 item、浮动 label 和 field 包装区域；不会移除子控件的: Overrides the item, floating label, and field wrapper separately without removing child controls' component class prefixes.
translation.分组内容；通常放置 Form.Item、Form.Grid 或 Form.Lis: Group content, usually Form.Item, Form.Grid, or Form.List, rendered in the body Grid.
translation.分组标题；与 description 一起生成 header，未传时分组仍可作为: Group title; forms a header together with description. Without a title, the group can still serve as a bordered Grid.
translation.分页、排序或筛选任一状态变化时统一回调。: A unified callback whenever pagination, sorting, or filtering changes.
translation.分页区域类名。: Class name for the pagination region.
translation.切换为简洁上一页/下一页布局。: Switches to a simplified previous-page/next-page layout.
translation.列宽受控变化时返回完整列宽映射。: Returns the complete column-width map when controlled column widths change.
translation.列宽拖动手柄类名。: Class name for the column-resize handle.
translation.列宽拖动时允许的最小像素宽度。: Minimum pixel width allowed when dragging a column-resize handle.
translation.列宽；数字按像素处理，参与 fixed 偏移和滚动布局。: Column width; numbers are treated as pixels and used for fixed offsets and scroll layout.
translation.列排序循环变化时回调，未排序时参数为 undefined。: Called when the column's sorting cycle changes; receives undefined when sorting is cleared.
translation.列显示/隐藏或上移/下移排序后返回完整键顺序。: Returns the complete key order after showing/hiding columns or moving them up/down.
translation.列显示隐藏或非 fixed 列上移/下移完成后返回完整键顺序。: Returns the complete key order after showing/hiding columns or moving non-fixed columns up/down.
translation.列树；叶子列决定实际单元格，多级 children 决定表头层级。: The column tree; leaf columns define actual cells and nested children define header levels.
translation.列的稳定唯一键，用于排序、筛选、列宽、显示隐藏和列设置持久化。: The column's stable unique key, used for sorting, filtering, widths, visibility, and persisted column settings.
translation.列表首次挂载且没有字段时写入的初始数组值。: The initial array value written when the list first mounts with no fields.
translation.创建多级表头；父列只参与表头，叶子列参与数据单元格。: Creates multi-level headers; parent columns appear only in headers, while leaf columns render data cells.
translation.加载行类名。: Class name for the loading row.
translation.动作图标；默认与文本一起渲染，只有 ButtonList 的 iconOnly=: Action icon; rendered with text by default. It becomes icon-only with Tooltip only when ButtonList has iconOnly=true and the action has an icon.
translation.动作按钮前的图标。: Icon before the action button's text.
translation.动作按钮显示内容。: Content displayed by the action button.
translation.动作被直接点击或从溢出菜单选择时执行；不伪造 MouseEvent。: Runs when the action is clicked directly or selected from the overflow menu; no MouseEvent is fabricated.
translation.区域内容；适合不需要 Form.Group header 的简单分区。: Section content, suited to simple sections that do not need a Form.Group header.
translation.单元格保存后返回完整数据和 key、column、value、record、in: Returns the complete data and key, column, value, record, and index after a cell is saved.
translation.单元格草稿保存成功时回调。: Called when the cell draft is saved successfully.
translation.单行切换后触发。: Called after a single row's selection is toggled.
translation.单行或全选变化后返回键和当前页对应的行。: Returns keys and their corresponding current-page rows when single-row or select-all selection changes.
translation.单行行高拖动提交后的回调；拖动完成后返回最终高度。: Called when a row-height drag is committed, with the final height.
translation.原生 table 元素类名。: Class name for the native table element.
translation.去掉 label/help 外壳，仅渲染 render props 返回的控件。: Removes the label/help wrapper and renders only the controls returned by render props.
translation.双击后开启当前列编辑；false 的列保持普通 Table 单元格。: Enables editing this column on double-click; columns set to false remain ordinary Table cells.
translation.发生编辑的列 key。: The key of the column being edited.
translation.发生编辑的行键。: The key of the row being edited.
translation.取消当前 AbortController 并清除 loading/fetchin: Cancels the current AbortController and clears loading/fetching state.
translation.取消当前单元格编辑时回调。: Called when editing of the current cell is cancelled.
translation.受控 Drawer 打开状态；需要配合 onDrawerOpenChange 回: Controlled Drawer open state; update it through onDrawerOpenChange.
translation.受控全屏状态；全屏时 ProTable 固定覆盖可用视口。: Controlled fullscreen state; ProTable covers the available viewport with fixed positioning in fullscreen.
translation.受控列宽映射，键为 Column.key。: Controlled column-width map, keyed by Column.key.
translation.受控可见列键顺序；外部必须在 onColumnKeysChange 后保存新数组: Controlled order of visible column keys; save the new array externally after onColumnKeysChange.
translation.受控打开完整筛选: Open all filters with controlled state
translation.受控排序字段和方向；传入后由外部保存排序状态。: Controlled sort field and direction; sorting state is maintained externally when provided.
translation.受控的可见列键和顺序；配合 onChange 保存显示隐藏与上移/下移结果。: Controlled visible column keys and order; use onChange to save visibility and move-up/move-down changes.
translation.受控筛选值；键为 Column.key，值为单值或多选值。: Controlled filter values, keyed by Column.key; each value may be a single selection or multiple selections.
translation.受控行高映射；键为 rowKey，数值为像素高度。: Controlled row-height map, keyed by rowKey, with heights in pixels.
translation.受控选中行键；传入后由外部维护选中状态。: Controlled selected row keys; selection state is maintained externally when provided.
translation.只显示列设置图标按钮并通过 Tooltip 说明；false 时显示标题文本。: Displays only the column-settings icon button with a Tooltip; false displays the title text.
translation.可用 render props 取得 field、fieldState、form: The render props provide field, fieldState, formState, disabled, and readOnly. Child nodes are not cloned; multiple controls can use field.onChange to compose one final backend field.
translation.可直接展开到 Table，包含 dataSource/loading/error: Can be spread directly onto Table, including dataSource/loading/error/pagination/sorter/filters and change callbacks.
translation.右侧操作区；组件只负责布局、对齐和间距，调用方负责按钮事件与受控查询状态。: Right-side action area; the component handles layout, alignment, and spacing, while the caller handles button events and controlled query state.
translation.合并新值后的当前行记录。: The current row record after merging the new value.
translation.向 onSorterChange 暴露的服务端排序字段名。: The server-side sort field name exposed to onSorterChange.
translation.启用 TanStack Virtual；仅滚动列表区域，需估算行高。: Enables TanStack Virtual; only the list region scrolls, and an estimated row height is required.
translation.启用展开行并控制展开键、展开渲染和可展开条件。: Enables expandable rows and controls expanded keys, expanded-content rendering, and expansion conditions.
translation.启用行复选框并控制选中键、选中行、全选和禁用行。: Enables row checkboxes and controls selected keys, selected rows, select-all behavior, and disabled rows.
translation.响应归一化成功后回调 QueryTableResponse<T>。: Called with QueryTableResponse<T> after the response is normalized successfully.
translation.固定当前筛选项宽度；未传时由 PageFilter 根据容器宽度自动计算轨道，固: Fixes this filter item's width. When omitted, PageFilter computes tracks from the container width. Fixed widths still participate in wrapping and overflow filter calculations.
translation.在 label 后渲染必填标记；不改变控件宽度、高度或提交校验。: Renders a required mark after label without changing control width, height, or submission validation.
translation.在字段标签区域显示额外说明，不参与字段值和校验。: Displays extra information in the field label area without affecting field values or validation.
translation.在对应 Form.List 表头文字后显示问号 Tooltip，用于解释该列的填: Displays a question-mark Tooltip after the corresponding Form.List header text to explain that column's input rules.
translation.在当前展示数据之后渲染汇总区域。: Renders a summary region after the currently displayed data.
translation.在标签旁显示公共 Tooltip；提示内容由调用方提供，不重复维护浮层实现。: Displays the shared Tooltip beside the label. The caller provides its content; no separate overlay implementation is maintained.
translation.在表单字段前渲染工具栏区域，适合放置筛选说明、状态或批量动作。: Renders a toolbar before form fields for filter explanations, status, or batch actions.
translation.在表头内渲染自定义筛选控件；适合不需要弹层的简单场景。: Renders custom filter controls inside the header for simple cases that do not need a popup.
translation.增加查询版本并重新请求；可选重置当前页。: Increments the query version and requests again, optionally resetting the current page.
translation.声明依赖字段；依赖变化时触发当前字段校验，适合联动字段。: Declares field dependencies and validates this field when they change, supporting dependent fields.
translation.声明内置筛选选项；选项支持 label、value、disabled。: Declares built-in filter options supporting label, value, and disabled.
translation.声明卸载时清理本地查询状态的契约；请求始终会 abort。: Declares whether local query state is cleared on unmount. Requests are always aborted.
translation.声明字段必填；当 rules 未提供 required 时自动注入当前语言的 r: Marks a field as required. If rules does not supply required, the required message for the current language is injected automatically.
translation.声明普通列及 editable 编辑配置；每列可独立选择编辑器类型。: Declares regular columns and editable configuration. Each column can choose its own editor type.
translation.声明表格所在层级，用于选择对应的样式语义和 z-index。: Declares the table's layer to select the corresponding style semantics and z-index.
translation.大于 0 时按毫秒定时 refresh；默认不轮询。: When greater than 0, schedules refresh at this interval in milliseconds. Polling is off by default.
translation.字段标签；渲染在控件上方/左侧，和 required、tooltip、extra: The field label appears above or beside the control, sharing the label region with required, tooltip, and extra.
translation.字段路径；传入时使用 Controller 注册到 form，支持嵌套路径和数组: The field path registers with form through Controller and supports nested and array paths.
translation.存在错误时显示 errorContent；可配合 ProTable 重试动作。: Displays errorContent when an error exists; can be combined with a ProTable retry action.
translation.完整的语义动作列表；列表负责显示、Tooltip、禁用和溢出收敛。: The complete semantic action list. The list handles display, Tooltip, disabled state, and overflow.
translation.完整筛选 Drawer 的标题；不改变 Drawer 的关闭、取消和确定行为。: The complete filter Drawer's title. It does not change Drawer close, cancel, or confirm behavior.
translation.定位编辑行并生成 onChange 的稳定 key。: Identifies the edited row and generates a stable key for onChange.
translation.密度菜单选择后回调新的密度值；与 density 一起使用时由调用方受控。: Returns the new density after a density menu selection. The caller controls it when used with density.
translation.将列固定在滚动容器左右；固定单元格保持不透明背景和正确层级。: Fixes columns to the left or right of the scroll container. Fixed cells retain opaque backgrounds and the correct layer.
translation.将原始值转换为单元格内容；ellipsis 会包裹最终内容。: Converts the raw value to cell content. ellipsis wraps the final content.
translation.展开键变化时返回完整键数组。: Returns the complete key array when expanded keys change.
translation.工具栏右侧内容，排在内置动作之后。: Right toolbar content, placed after the built-in actions.
translation.工具栏左侧内容，适合标题、已选数量、批量动作和快速筛选；与表格状态解耦。: Left toolbar content for titles, selection counts, batch actions, or quick filters, independent of table state.
translation.应用待选值；closeDropdown=false 时保留面板打开。: Applies pending values. closeDropdown=false keeps the panel open.
translation.当前列声明的可选项。: Options declared by the current column.
translation.当前列已应用或待应用的筛选键。: Applied or pending filter keys for the current column.
translation.当前可见叶子列键顺序；函数不会修改传入数组，而是返回新的顺序数组。: The order of currently visible leaf column keys. The function returns a new ordered array without mutating its input.
translation.当前数据源中的行索引。: The row index in the current data source.
translation.当前页大小；与 showSizeChanger 一起控制每页条数。: Current page size; works with showSizeChanger to control rows per page.
translation.总记录数；服务端分页时由接口返回。: Total record count, returned by the API for server-side pagination.
translation.总页数不超过 1 时隐藏分页器。: Hides pagination when the total number of pages is at most 1.
translation.恢复初始参数、排序、筛选和分页并重新查询。: Restores initial parameters, sorting, filters, and pagination, then queries again.
translation.批量动作异常时回调；新增、导出等业务动作由 toolbarRight 自行管理。: Called when a batch action fails. Application actions such as create and export are managed independently by toolbarRight.
translation.批量动作稳定唯一键，也用于 pendingAction 和错误回调。: A stable unique batch action key, also used by pendingAction and the error callback.
translation.批量动作配置；无选中行时默认禁用，支持异步 loading 和 danger。: Batch action configuration. Disabled by default when no rows are selected; supports asynchronous loading and danger.
translation.把只读语义传给 Form.Item 的 render props；具体输入控件是: Passes read-only semantics to Form.Item render props. Input controls decide how to consume readOnly to prevent editing.
translation.拖动可调整叶子列的手柄后返回列 key 和不小于 minWidth 的宽度。: After dragging a resizable leaf column handle, returns the column key and a width no smaller than minWidth.
translation.指定依赖字段触发 form.trigger 的时机；未传时保留 react-ho: Specifies when dependent fields trigger form.trigger. When omitted, react-hook-form's default validation timing is preserved.
translation.指定稳定动态普通列；直接拖动它时以前一普通列反向补偿，其他普通列拖动时由它按当前: Specifies a stable dynamic regular column. Dragging it adjusts the previous regular column in the opposite direction; when other regular columns are dragged, it gradually absorbs the change using its current width. false or scroll.x=max-content uses the exact total content width and independent resizing.
translation.按 paginationParamNames 生成的接口分页参数。: API pagination parameters generated according to paginationParamNames.
translation.按 root、fields、actions、more、drawer、drawer: Adds separate style classes to root, fields, actions, more, drawer, drawerPanel, drawerBody, and drawerFooter.
translation.按记录决定是否显示展开按钮。: Determines whether to show the expand button for each record.
translation.按记录禁用复选框或设置可访问名称。: Disables checkboxes or sets accessible names per record.
translation.排序列标题；仅在 showSort=true 时渲染。: The sort column title, rendered only when showSort=true.
translation.接收 react-hook-form 创建的表单实例；字段注册、校验、reset: Accepts the form instance created by react-hook-form. Field registration, validation, reset, watch, and submission state all come from this instance.
translation.接收 selectedKeys、selectedRows、dataSource: A synchronous or asynchronous action receiving selectedKeys, selectedRows, and dataSource.
translation.控制 label 文本后是否显示冒号。: Controls whether a colon is displayed after label text.
translation.控制分组是否显示边框；false 只保留标题、Grid 和 spacing。: Controls the group border. false retains only the title, Grid, and spacing.
translation.控制带 required/rules.required 的 Form.Item: Controls whether Form.Item with required/rules.required displays the required mark.
translation.控制表格行的纵向密度。: Controls the vertical density of table rows.
translation.控制错误汇总默认文案语言；未传时读取 Form scope。: Controls the default error summary language. When omitted, it reads the Form scope.
translation.操作区内容；按钮间距由公共 ButtonGroup 或 Actions CSS: Action region content. The shared ButtonGroup or Actions CSS handles button spacing.
translation.放置 TextField、Select、DatePicker 等实际筛选控件；控: Contains actual filter controls such as TextField, Select, and DatePicker. Controls retain their own borders and fill the item width by default.
translation.数据源变化或分页后是否保留不存在于当前页的已选键。: Whether to retain selected keys absent from the current page after data source or pagination changes.
translation.文本、文本域和数字控件失焦保存前触发。: Called before text, textarea, and number controls save on blur.
translation.无数据时替换默认空态文案或组件。: Replaces the default empty-state text or component when there is no data.
translation.是否为 columns 模式每行渲染删除按钮；false 时保留字段但不显示内置: Whether to render a delete button for each row in columns mode. false retains fields while hiding the built-in delete action.
translation.是否为数据行启用斑马纹；开启后偶数行使用比 hover 更浅的灰色背景。: Whether to stripe data rows. Even rows use a gray background lighter than hover when enabled.
translation.是否允许该叶子列拖动调整宽度；只有显式传 true 才渲染拖动手柄。: Whether this leaf column can be resized by dragging. A handle appears only when explicitly set to true.
translation.是否在工具栏显示全屏切换按钮；可与列设置、密度工具独立关闭，显示时使用 seco: Whether to show the toolbar fullscreen toggle, independently of column settings and density tools. Uses a centered secondary contained icon button when shown.
translation.是否在工具栏显示紧凑/默认/宽松密度菜单；关闭时不渲染密度按钮，显示时使用 se: Whether to show the compact/default/comfortable density menu in the toolbar. Disabling it removes the density button; otherwise it uses a centered secondary contained icon button.
translation.是否在最前面显示排序列；开启后显示拖动手柄以及上移/下移按钮。: Whether to show the sort column first. Enabling it shows a drag handle and move up/down buttons.
translation.是否在紧凑程度下拉底部显示空心重置表格按钮。: Whether to show the outlined Reset Table button at the bottom of the density dropdown.
translation.是否展示页大小选择器。: Whether to show the page size selector.
translation.是否显示列设置；列设置负责显示隐藏和非固定列上移/下移排序，默认工具组使用 se: Whether to show column settings for visibility and move up/down ordering of non-fixed columns. The default tool group uses centered secondary contained icon buttons.
translation.是否显示输入页码并支持回车快速跳转。: Whether to show a page number input supporting Enter to jump.
translation.是否渲染 columns 模式底部新增按钮；false 时仍可通过 childr: Whether to render the bottom add button in columns mode. With false, rows can still be added through children operations.add.
translation.是否渲染行高拖动手柄；默认关闭，可按行开启。: Whether to render row resize handles. Off by default; can be enabled per row.
translation.是否渲染表头、排序、筛选和列宽调整区域。: Whether to render the header, sorting, filtering, and column resize regions.
translation.显式 left/right 按物理方向对齐；未指定时按 dir 的阅读起点对齐，: Explicit left/right aligns to physical directions. Otherwise alignment follows the reading start from dir; center stays centered.
translation.显式设置 ProTable 及其 Table 的阅读方向；组件不读取 Runti: Explicitly sets the reading direction for ProTable and its Table. The component does not read Runtime or ConfigProvider direction and defaults to LTR when omitted.
translation.显式设置表格阅读方向；组件不读取 Runtime 或 ConfigProvide: Explicitly sets the table reading direction. The component does not read Runtime or ConfigProvider direction and defaults to LTR when omitted. Default text aligns to the reading start; explicit column align=left/right still follows physical directions.
translation.显示加载态并替换当前行；不会清除外部 dataSource。: Displays the loading state in place of current rows without clearing external dataSource.
translation.显示在标题下方的分组说明，不参与表单提交。: Group description displayed below the title; excluded from form submission.
translation.更新业务参数并重置分页到第一页。: Updates application parameters and resets pagination to the first page.
translation.更新待应用值，不立即关闭筛选面板。: Updates pending values without immediately closing the filter panel.
translation.替换 table/header/body/row/cell 元素类型；不会改变数: Replaces the table/header/body/row/cell element types without changing data state.
translation.替换溢出按钮图标；按钮仍保留 secondary contained small: Replaces the overflow button icon. The button retains secondary contained small semantics; menu items display text only.
translation.替换筛选按钮图标；函数可根据当前是否已筛选改变图标。: Replaces the filter button icon. A function can change the icon based on whether filtering is active.
translation.替换默认筛选面板；context 提供 selectedKeys、confirm: Replaces the default filter panel. context provides selectedKeys, confirm, clearFilters, and close.
translation.替换默认编辑控件；context 提供 value、record、draft、s: Replaces the default editor. context provides value, record, draft, setDraft, save, cancel, and clear for composing multiple controls or application components.
translation.最近一次未取消请求的原始错误。: The raw error from the latest request that was not cancelled.
translation.未传自定义 actions 时，点击自动生成的查询按钮触发。: Called when the automatically generated query button is clicked and no custom actions are supplied.
translation.未传自定义 actions 时，点击自动生成的重置按钮触发。: Called when the automatically generated reset button is clicked and no custom actions are supplied.
translation.栅格内容；Form.Item 会占据一个 grid track，控件由 Form: Grid content. Each Form.Item occupies one grid track, and Form styles stretch controls consistently.
translation.标记异步提交中；设置 aria-busy 并禁用 fieldset，避免重复编辑: Marks asynchronous submission with aria-busy and disables fieldset to prevent duplicate editing and submission.
translation.标记操作列；列不参与余量分配或其他列的拖动补偿。宽度按浏览器视口宽度响应式设置为: Marks an action column, excluding it from remaining-space allocation and resize compensation for other columns. Width adapts to the browser viewport as 60/160/190px for below 560px, 560–799px, and 800px or wider. The corresponding default ButtonList maxCount values are 1/3/5, including More. Explicit or controlled column widths and custom ButtonList limits take priority. Dragging still requires explicit resizable.
translation.标识查询缓存边界；分页是否纳入由 includePaginationInQuer: Identifies the query cache boundary. includePaginationInQueryKey controls whether pagination is included.

translation.渲染 legend 下方的说明段落，不负责字段状态。: Renders the description below the legend without managing field state.
translation.渲染在表格滚动区与 Pagination 之间的独立扩展区域；不会混入 Tool: Renders a separate extension region between the table's scroll area and Pagination; it remains separate from Toolbar, table rows, and pagination state.
translation.渲染表格 caption，提供可访问的表格摘要。: Renders the table caption to provide an accessible table summary.
translation.溢出按钮的 Tooltip 和无障碍名称文案。: Tooltip text and accessible name for the overflow button.
translation.用于取消旧请求、组件卸载请求和手动 cancel。: Used to cancel previous requests, requests on component unmount, and manual cancel operations.
translation.用于生成列设置项；只处理叶子列，fixed 列保持原位置且不可隐藏或排序。: Generates column-settings items from leaf columns only; fixed columns retain their positions and cannot be hidden or reordered.
translation.监听双击进入编辑的事件，可在打开编辑器前记录日志或同步业务状态。: Listens for double-click entry into editing; use it to log events or synchronize business state before the editor opens.
translation.直接拖动列宽时允许的最大像素宽度；自动填充为避免表格尾部留白可以超过此值。: Maximum pixel width allowed when directly dragging a column-resize handle; automatic filling may exceed it to avoid blank space at the table's trailing edge.
translation.禁用整个表单 fieldset，并把字段上下文的 disabled 设为 tru: Disables the entire form fieldset and sets disabled to true in the field context; loading during submission also disables fields.

translation.纵向滚动尺寸；虚拟列表使用该滚动容器。: Vertical scroll size; the virtual list uses this scroll container.
translation.统一监听开始、保存、取消、清空和失焦编辑动作。: A unified listener for edit start, save, cancel, clear, and blur actions.
translation.编辑控件上方右侧提供紧凑的灰色取消、红色清空和绿色保存按钮；清空保持编辑态，文本: Shows compact gray cancel, red clear, and green save buttons above the editor on the right. Clearing keeps edit mode active, text controls still save on blur, and Esc exits editing.
translation.编辑表格当前数据；外部更新时同步内部编辑数据。: The editable table's current data; external updates synchronize the internal editing data.
translation.自定义加载态内容，适合接入 Loading 或 Skeleton。: Custom loading-state content, such as Loading or Skeleton.

translation.追加到工具栏右侧末尾的自定义内容；组件不内置新增、导出或刷新按钮。: Custom content appended at the far right of the toolbar; the component does not include built-in add, export, or refresh buttons.
translation.追加到根 form 的 biu-form 前缀类名之后，用于页面级布局覆盖。: Adds a class name after the root form's biu-form class prefix for page-level layout overrides.

translation.选择分页、空态、筛选和选择相关的默认文案。: Selects default text for pagination, empty states, filtering, and selection.
translation.选择表单内置文案语言；默认中文，缺失资源按包内回退规则处理。: Selects the form's built-in text locale; defaults to Chinese, with missing resources handled by the package's fallback rules.
