translation.为面板定位增加安全区偏移。: Adds a safe-area offset to panel positioning.
translation.仅在实际溢出时显示箭头；none 保留滚动但不显示箭头。: Shows arrows only when content actually overflows. none preserves scrolling without showing arrows.
translation.仅在触发内容真实溢出时显示 Tooltip。: Shows Tooltip only when trigger content actually overflows.
translation.以 CSS-in-JS 对象、数组或函数设置根节点样式；数组按顺序合并。: Sets root styles using a CSS-in-JS object, array, or function. Arrays merge in order.
translation.以 URL 渲染统一文件预览。: Renders a unified file preview from a URL.
translation.任意 ReactNode，可多行: Any ReactNode; multiple lines are supported
translation.任意数字且不小于 min: Any number not less than min
translation.传给 Ellipsis；默认仅真实溢出时显示完整文本 Tooltip。: Passed to Ellipsis. By default, the complete-text Tooltip appears only on actual overflow.
translation.使用公共 Ellipsis 展示长值，默认仅溢出时提示。: Uses the shared Ellipsis to display long values, showing a hint only on overflow by default.
translation.使用原生 style 覆写 css 和 sx 的同名样式。: Uses native style to override matching properties from css and sx.
translation.使用弱化文本颜色显示内容。: Displays content in a muted text color.
translation.使用强调字重显示文本。: Displays text with an emphasized font weight.
translation.使用数据源和 renderItem 渲染统一的列表容器。: Uses a data source and renderItem to render a unified list container.
translation.使用统一间距排列一组内容，支持方向、对齐、换行和分隔节点。: Arranges content with consistent spacing, supporting direction, alignment, wrapping, and separator nodes.
translation.保留兼容签名但开关视觉只展示圆形滑块，避免文字导致变形。: Retains the compatible signature, but the switch displays only a circular thumb to prevent text from distorting its shape.
translation.保留内容可读但禁止编辑。: Keeps content readable while preventing editing.
translation.保留可读视觉但阻止点击修改。: Keeps the readable appearance while preventing click changes.
translation.保留当前状态但禁止切换。: Keeps the current state while preventing toggling.
translation.保留根前缀并按弹层区域覆写样式。: Retains the root prefix and overrides styles by overlay region.
translation.值、当前 option、选项索引: Value, current option, and option index
translation.像素或四边配置: Pixels or configuration for all four sides
translation.允许在视窗范围内拖动进度组件；static 普通布局保持调用方安排的位置。: Allows dragging the progress component within the viewport. Normal static layout retains the position arranged by the caller.
translation.允许拖动 fixed 消息在视窗内调整位置；普通流布局不适用。: Allows dragging a fixed message within the viewport. Does not apply to normal flow layout.
translation.允许标签列表滚动。: Allows the tab list to scroll.
translation.先展示基础单选，再展示搜索单选、600 条数据懒加载单选和多选；支持全部、全选、: Starts with basic single selection, followed by searchable single selection, lazy single selection with 600 items, and multiple selection. Supports All, Select All, three-argument onChange, custom option/label/tag, and dropdown slots.
translation.先选择到第四层: Select through the fourth level first
translation.关闭时是否卸载组合内容。: Whether to unmount composed content on close.
translation.兼容属性；当前轨道不渲染文字: Compatibility property; the current track does not render text
translation.内容、按钮和表单由业务自由组合，焦点、ESC、遮罩和 Portal 由组件处理。: Application code freely composes content, buttons, and forms. The component handles focus, ESC, overlay, and Portal.
translation.内容超出可用宽度时显示单行省略。: Displays a single-line ellipsis when content exceeds the available width.
translation.内置输入规则：纯数字、纯字母、字母数字: Built-in input rules: digits only, letters only, and alphanumeric
translation.决定两侧日期输出格式。: Determines the date output format for both sides.
translation.决定两侧时间输出格式。: Determines the time output format for both sides.
translation.决定时间列和输出格式。: Determines time columns and output format.
translation.决定面板列和触发器输出格式。: Determines panel columns and trigger output format.
translation.减少中间可见页码数量。: Reduces the number of visible page numbers in the middle.
translation.分别控制受控值或非受控初始值；range 模式返回两个值。: Controls the value or uncontrolled initial value separately; range mode returns two values.
translation.分别控制垂直布局和视觉方向反转，不改变实际数值语义。: Controls vertical layout and visual direction reversal separately without changing numeric semantics.
translation.分别覆写组根节点和克隆子按钮的样式。: Overrides styles for the group root and cloned child buttons separately.
translation.分别设置复制按钮和复制成功状态的 Tooltip/无障碍文案。: Sets Tooltip/accessibility text separately for the copy button and copied state.
translation.分组标题；可以只传 icon 或完全不传。: Group title; icon alone or neither may be supplied.
translation.分页或页大小变化后的回调。: Callback after the page or page size changes.
translation.切换两侧的 12 小时制和 24 小时制。: Switches both sides between 12-hour and 24-hour formats.
translation.切换简约表面与整块语义底色表面；复杂模式会同步调整文字和图标对比度。: Switches between a simple surface and a full semantic-color surface. Complex mode also adjusts text and icon contrast.
translation.刻度值到文案或 { label, style }: Map from mark values to text or { label, style }
translation.勾选变化后的回调。: Callback after the checked state changes.
translation.勾选变化时触发。: Called when the checked state changes.
translation.包裹需要响应右键菜单的内容区域。: Wraps the content region that should respond to the context menu.
translation.单值或范围二元组: Single value or a range tuple
translation.单向模式 oneWay：只能从左侧移入右侧: One-way mode oneWay: move only from left to right
translation.单选菜单值变化后的回调。: Callback after the radio menu value changes.
translation.即使没有溢出也可以通过 alwaysTooltip 永远显示完整 Tooltip: alwaysTooltip can keep the complete Tooltip visible even without overflow.
translation.即使没有溢出也显示完整 Tooltip；默认只在真实溢出时显示。: Displays the complete Tooltip even without overflow. By default, it appears only on actual overflow.
translation.双向模式：右侧默认可删除移回: Two-way mode: removal moves items back from the right by default
translation.双栏数据转移，支持搜索/禁用/自定义标题和条目末端操作；双向模式右侧默认提供删除: Transfers data between two columns with search, disabling, custom titles, and actions at the logical end of items. Two-way mode provides a remove button on the right by default; oneWay allows only left-to-right movement.
translation.受控两栏搜索文本。: Controlled search text for both columns.
translation.受控右侧目标数据。: Controlled target data on the right.
translation.受控和非受控联动，onChange 返回最新值，选项可独立禁用。: Controlled and uncontrolled coordination. onChange returns the latest value, and options may be disabled individually.
translation.受控已选值；需配合 onChange 回写。: Controlled selected value; update it through onChange.
translation.受控或非受控单选菜单状态。: Controlled or uncontrolled radio menu state.
translation.受控或非受控地设置当前颜色。: Sets the current color in a controlled or uncontrolled way.
translation.受控或非受控复选项状态。: Controlled or uncontrolled checkbox item state.
translation.受控或非受控管理一级、二级目录节点的折叠状态。: Manages collapse state for first- and second-level directory nodes in a controlled or uncontrolled way.
translation.受控文本内容；需配合 onChange 回写。: Controlled text content; update it through onChange.
translation.受控日期范围；组件自动规范起止顺序。: Controlled date range; the component automatically normalizes start/end order.
translation.受控时间范围；编辑任一侧都会保留另一侧值。: Controlled time range; editing either side preserves the other side's value.
translation.受控输入内容；需配合 onChange 回写。: Controlled input content; update it through onChange.
translation.受控选择值；需配合 onChange 回写。: Controlled selection value; update it through onChange.
translation.只允许从左侧移动到右侧。: Allows movement only from left to right.
translation.只在指定的级联列渲染搜索框；例如 [3] 仅搜索第四层。: Renders search inputs only in the specified cascade columns. For example, [3] searches only the fourth level.
translation.只控制当前分组是否显示背景和边框。: Controls only whether the current group shows its background and border.
translation.只有一页时隐藏整个分页器。: Hides the entire paginator when there is only one page.
translation.右侧双向模式默认移除按钮: Default remove button on the right in two-way mode
translation.后端未知值回显（不在 options 中）: Display an unknown backend value (absent from options)
translation.后端未知目标项：置顶、禁选，但仍可删除: Unknown backend target item: pinned to the top and disabled for selection, but still removable
translation.后端未知路径回显（当前 options 未加载）: Display an unknown backend path (current options are not loaded)
translation.后端返回项：legacy-runtime（当前列表暂无）: Backend item: legacy-runtime (currently absent from the list)
translation.向组件树提供全局主题标识和方向配置。: Provides a global theme identifier and direction configuration for the component tree.
translation.启用 Radix 碰撞检测和自动翻转。: Enables Radix collision detection and automatic flipping.
translation.启用多选、复选以及是否级联父子勾选。: Enables multiple selection, checkboxes, and optional parent/child cascading of checked states.
translation.启用多选和拖拽选择。: Enables multiple selection and drag selection.
translation.启用小屏紧凑模式；只渲染百分比文本和回到顶部按钮，并忽略 label 与进度条展: Enables compact mode on small screens. Renders only percentage text and the back-to-top button, ignoring label and progress bar display settings.
translation.启用模态焦点管理和背景交互隔离。: Enables modal focus management and isolation from background interaction.
translation.启用模态焦点管理和背景隔离。: Enables modal focus management and background isolation.
translation.响应式网格，统一处理列数和间距。: Responsive grid with consistent column counts and spacing.
translation.四方向占满对应 viewport 边缘，支持 size、fullscreen 和: Fills the corresponding viewport edge for any of four directions, supporting size, fullscreen, and composable header/footer.
translation.图片地址、替代文本和尺寸: Image URL, alternative text, and dimensions
translation.在下拉面板顶部启用 sticky 搜索框。: Enables a sticky search input at the top of the dropdown panel.
translation.在下拉面板顶部或底部渲染业务内容。: Renders application content at the top or bottom of the dropdown panel.
translation.在两栏内显示搜索框。: Displays search inputs in both columns.
translation.在内容组之间提供清晰的视觉分隔。: Provides a clear visual separator between content groups.
translation.在内容逻辑末端渲染操作区（LTR 右侧、RTL 左侧）。: Renders actions at the logical end of content (right in LTR, left in RTL).
translation.在分隔线上渲染文本或节点。: Renders text or a node on the divider.
translation.在列表顶部或底部渲染附加内容。: Renders additional content above or below the list.
translation.在单选框右侧渲染标签。: Renders a label to the right of the radio.
translation.在复选框右侧渲染标签。: Renders a label to the right of the checkbox.
translation.在字段标签后渲染问号图标，hover/focus 展示说明。: Renders a question-mark icon after the field label; hover/focus shows the explanation.
translation.在指定内容区域打开可操作的右键菜单。: Opens an actionable context menu in the specified content region.
translation.在指定数值位置展示刻度和标签。: Displays marks and labels at specified numeric positions.
translation.在按钮中渲染图标。: Renders an icon inside the button.
translation.在文件名下方显示文件大小。: Displays file size below the file name.
translation.在文本域右侧渲染后置内容。: Renders trailing content to the right of the textarea.
translation.在文本域左侧渲染前置内容。: Renders leading content to the left of the textarea.
translation.在日期选择中增加时间列。: Adds time columns to date selection.
translation.在末尾渲染待处理节点。: Renders a pending node at the end.
translation.在标签列表末尾渲染新增操作。: Renders an add action at the end of the tab list.
translation.在每个 step 位置显示辅助刻度点。: Shows an auxiliary tick at every step position.
translation.在每个级联列启用紧凑搜索，只过滤当前列。: Enables compact search in each cascade column, filtering only that column.
translation.在输入框右侧渲染后置内容。: Renders trailing content to the right of the input.
translation.在输入框左侧渲染前置内容。: Renders leading content to the left of the input.
translation.在进度条前显示可选说明，窄屏会自动隐藏以保留按钮空间。: Displays optional explanatory text before the progress bar. Narrow screens hide it automatically to preserve button space.
translation.在选项首位自动添加“全部”选项。: Automatically adds All as the first option.
translation.在页面行内末端打开可关闭通知（LTR 右侧、RTL 左侧）。: Opens a dismissible notification at the inline end of the page (right in LTR, left in RTL).
translation.基座和业务页面中的超长文本都会自动检测并在需要时显示完整 Tooltip 内容。: Long text in the shell and application pages is detected automatically; the full Tooltip appears when needed.
translation.增量加载或当前列搜索加载函数: Incremental loading or current-column search loader
translation.处理当前文件项操作。: Handles actions on the current file item.
translation.复制到剪贴板的原始文本；即使 content 自定义展示，也始终复制该值。: The original text copied to the clipboard. This value is always copied, even when content customizes the display.
translation.复制成功后接收原始文本；组件优先使用 Clipboard API，失败时降级到: Receives the original text after a successful copy. The component tries the Clipboard API first and falls back to execCommand on failure.
translation.复制按钮默认持续展示；开启后仅容器 hover 或 focus 时展示。: The copy button stays visible by default. When enabled, it appears only on container hover or focus.
translation.复杂内容可以直接放入。: Complex content can be inserted directly.
translation.多选、全选与标签省略: Multiple selection, select all, and tag ellipsis
translation.多选模式下显示一键全选/取消全选操作。: Shows one-click select all/deselect all actions in multiple selection mode.
translation.大于等于 1 的页码: A page number greater than or equal to 1
translation.定义单选选项和每项的禁用状态。: Defines radio options and the disabled state of each option.
translation.定义复选选项和每项的禁用状态。: Defines checkbox options and the disabled state of each option.
translation.定义左侧可选数据。: Defines the selectable data on the left.
translation.定义标签、面板内容和关闭状态。: Defines tab labels, panel content, and closability.
translation.定义树节点层级和节点状态。: Defines the tree hierarchy and node states.
translation.定义步骤标题、说明、状态和禁用状态。: Defines step titles, descriptions, statuses, and disabled states.
translation.定义目录和菜单树。: Defines the directory and menu tree.
translation.定义该区域中的标签、值、渲染方式和跨列规则。: Defines the labels, values, rendering, and column spans in this section.
translation.定义面包屑层级和每项导航行为。: Defines the breadcrumb hierarchy and navigation behavior for each item.
translation.将按钮转换为组件统一控制的方形独立图标按钮；按钮内不渲染文字，文字自动作为 To: Turns the button into a square standalone icon button with geometry managed by the component; no text is rendered inside, and the text automatically becomes the Tooltip content.
translation.小屏自动隐藏 Anchor，避免目录挤压内容；static 模式同样遵守该约束。: Automatically hides Anchor on small screens to keep the outline from squeezing content; the same constraint applies in static mode.
translation.尺寸、对齐、换行和分隔节点: Size, alignment, wrapping, and separator nodes
translation.尺寸变化后同步当前宽高。: Synchronizes the current width and height after a size change.
translation.展开尚未加载的节点时按需加载子节点；失败由 onLoadError 接收并保留当: Loads children on demand when an unloaded node is expanded; onLoadError receives failures while the current tree state is preserved.
translation.展开状态变化后的回调。: Callback after the expanded state changes.
translation.展开目录变化后的回调。: Callback after the expanded outline sections change.
translation.展示可快速选择的预设色块。: Shows preset color swatches for quick selection.
translation.展示时间顺序、处理状态和进行中节点。: Shows chronological order, processing status, and in-progress nodes.
translation.展示流程进度和当前处理节点。: Shows workflow progress and the node currently being processed.
translation.底部进度条按 scrollTop 与可滚动总高度计算；滚动超过阈值后显示小型回顶: The bottom progress bar is calculated from scrollTop and the total scrollable height; a small back-to-top button appears after scrolling past the threshold.
translation.开关状态变化后的回调。: Callback after the switch state changes.
translation.开启双滑块范围选择，返回 [start, end]。: Enables range selection with two thumbs and returns [start, end].
translation.当前标签变化后的回调。: Callback after the active tab changes.
translation.当前标题因滚动或点击变化时回调。: Called when the active heading changes through scrolling or clicking.
translation.当前筛选条件下暂无数据: No data matches the current filters
translation.当前级联列搜索关键词变化后的回调。: Callback after the search keyword in the current cascader column changes.
translation.当前节点；返回子节点或 Promise: Current node; returns child nodes or a Promise
translation.当前详情记录；字段默认从该对象读取。: The current detail record; fields read from this object by default.
translation.徽标附着的业务内容。: The business content to which the badge is attached.
translation.总数据条数。: The total number of data records.
translation.懒加载、加载中和失败内容: Lazy loading, loading content, and error content
translation.所有组件按统一顺序逐块展示；效果案例和属性/方法表同时作为可运行文档，基础能力与: All components are shown section by section in a consistent order; examples and property/method tables serve as runnable documentation, with basic capabilities and enterprise scenarios presented on one page.
translation.手动限制测量宽度，实际溢出后才显示 Tooltip。: Manually limits the measurement width; Tooltip appears only when content actually overflows.
translation.扩展下拉面板整体、顶部或底部内容。: Extends the entire dropdown panel or its top or bottom content.
translation.拖动、点击或键盘调整时同步最新值。: Synchronizes the latest value during dragging, clicking, or keyboard adjustment.
translation.拖动右下角调整大小，子内容保持在容器内部。: Drag the bottom-right corner to resize; child content stays inside the container.
translation.拖拽或选择文件，演示类型/大小校验、模拟上传进度、取消/重试、大小/时间、下载和: Drag or select files to try type/size validation, simulated upload progress, cancel/retry, size/time information, download, and preview.
translation.指定 Portal 容器，默认挂载 body 避免层级裁剪。: Specifies the Portal container; mounts to body by default to avoid clipping by ancestor layers.
translation.指定原生 radio 分组名称。: Specifies the native radio group name.
translation.指定可以独立折叠子标题的层级；collapsible=true 时默认允许一级和: Specifies the heading levels whose subheadings can be collapsed independently; collapsible=true allows first- and second-level headings to collapse by default.
translation.指定展示文件名和预览类型。: Specifies the displayed filename and preview type.
translation.指定或自动识别预览类型。: Specifies the preview type or detects it automatically.
translation.指定标题定位和当前项计算所使用的滚动上下文。: Specifies the scroll context used to locate headings and calculate the active item.
translation.指定要扫描标题的内容容器；未传入时扫描当前 document。: Specifies the content container to scan for headings; scans the current document when omitted.
translation.指定要计算滚动进度并执行回顶的对象。: Specifies the target used to calculate scroll progress and perform back-to-top scrolling.
translation.按 Drawer 根节点和各区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the Drawer root and its regions.
translation.按上传区、列表、文件项和操作区覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the upload area, list, file items, and action area.
translation.按两侧时间、连接符和 footer 区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for both time fields, the separator, and the footer.
translation.按分组和选项区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the group and option regions.
translation.按分隔线和中间内容覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the divider and its center content.
translation.按加载器和文案区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the loader and text regions.
translation.按卡片各区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for each card region.
translation.按可编辑前缀过滤输入和粘贴内容；固定长度等最终校验使用 Form.Item.ru: Filters typed and pasted content by valid editable prefixes; uses Form.Item.rules.pattern for final validation such as fixed length.
translation.按字符过滤纯数字、纯英文字母或字母数字混合输入；允许清空后继续编辑。: Filters characters to allow only digits, English letters, or alphanumeric input; the value can be cleared and edited again.
translation.按开关根节点和滑块区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the switch root and thumb region.
translation.按徽标根节点、数字和圆点区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the badge root, number, and dot regions.
translation.按提示各区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for each alert region.
translation.按搜索框、层级、图标和标题区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the search box, hierarchy, icon, and title regions.
translation.按数字、文本和连接线区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the number, text, and connector regions.
translation.按文件列表和文件项区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the file list and file item regions.
translation.按文本域区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the textarea region.
translation.按日期、时间、预设和 footer 区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the date, time, preset, and footer regions.
translation.按时间列、连接符和 footer 区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the time columns, separator, and footer regions.
translation.按时间列禁用具体时段。: Disables specific time periods by time column.
translation.按标签、面板、滚动箭头和关闭按钮覆写样式。: Overrides styles for tabs, panels, scroll arrows, and close buttons.
translation.按根节点、列表、项和分隔符覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the root, list, items, and separators.
translation.按根节点、原生 input 和标签区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the root, native input, and label regions.
translation.按根节点、图标、加载器和文字区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the root, icon, loader, and text regions.
translation.按根节点、触发器和内容区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the root, trigger, and content regions.
translation.按气泡各区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for each popover region.
translation.按滑块各结构区域覆写样式，不改变交互。: Overrides styles for slider structural regions without changing interactions.
translation.按目录、折叠和工具按钮区域追加定制 class。: Adds custom class values to the outline, collapse, and tool-button regions.
translation.按空状态根节点和文案区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the empty-state root and text regions.
translation.按级别受控或非受控搜索文本: Controlled or uncontrolled search text by level
translation.按级联层级点击节点后懒加载子节点；返回空数组时将当前节点作为叶子提交。: Lazy-loads children when a node is clicked at a cascader level; an empty array submits the current node as a leaf.
translation.按范围两侧、日历和快捷选择区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for both range endpoints, the calendar, and the quick-selection region.
translation.按菜单导航、层级和条目区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for menu navigation, hierarchy, and item regions.
translation.按菜单层级和标签区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for menu hierarchy and label regions.
translation.按触发器、内容和箭头区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the trigger, content, and arrow regions.
translation.按触发器、面板、选项和标签区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the trigger, panel, options, and tags.
translation.按语义类型快速打开通知。: Quickly opens a notification by semantic type.
translation.按起止位置禁用时间选项。: Disables time options according to the start or end position.
translation.按输入框区域覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the input region.
translation.按进度、数值、说明和回顶按钮区域追加定制 class。: Adds custom class values to the progress, value, description, and back-to-top button regions.
translation.按进度根节点、轨道和填充条覆写样式。: Overrides styles for the progress root, track, and fill bar.
translation.按钮语义色；danger 是 error 的兼容别名。: The button semantic color; danger is a compatibility alias for error.
translation.按顺序渲染详情分组，每个分组可以有自己的列数和边框。: Renders detail groups in order; each group can have its own column count and border.
translation.接收 Dialog 状态和关闭原因。: Receives Dialog state and the close reason.
translation.接收 Drawer 状态和关闭原因。: Receives Drawer state and the close reason.
translation.接收预览弹层开关变化。: Receives changes to the preview overlay open state.
translation.控制 ESC 或遮罩点击是否关闭。: Controls whether ESC or a backdrop click closes the overlay.
translation.控制两栏当前勾选项。: Controls the currently checked items in both columns.
translation.控制原生文本域可调整的方向，组件不绘制额外拖拽图标。: Controls the native textarea resize direction; the component does not draw an additional drag icon.
translation.控制取消或确定按钮是否渲染。: Controls whether the cancel or confirm button is rendered.
translation.控制受控或非受控勾选节点。: Controls checked nodes in controlled or uncontrolled mode.
translation.控制受控或非受控展开状态。: Controls the expanded state in controlled or uncontrolled mode.
translation.控制受控或非受控展开目录。: Controls expanded outline sections in controlled or uncontrolled mode.
translation.控制受控或非受控展开节点。: Controls expanded nodes in controlled or uncontrolled mode.
translation.控制受控或非受控当前步骤。: Controls the current step in controlled or uncontrolled mode.
translation.控制受控或非受控打开状态。: Controls the open state in controlled or uncontrolled mode.
translation.控制受控或非受控显示状态。: Controls visibility in controlled or uncontrolled mode.
translation.控制受控或非受控选中节点。: Controls selected nodes in controlled or uncontrolled mode.
translation.控制回顶按钮出现的最小滚动距离。: Controls the minimum scroll distance before the back-to-top button appears.
translation.控制图标位于文字前、后或居中。: Controls whether the icon appears before the text, after it, or centered.
translation.控制字段横跨的栅格数量。: Controls the number of grid columns spanned by a field.
translation.控制当前级联列是否还有数据及是否处于加载中。: Controls whether the current cascader column has more data and is loading.
translation.控制当前选中的级联路径。: Controls the currently selected cascader path.
translation.控制按钮圆角、圆形或方形形状。: Controls whether the button has rounded corners, a circular shape, or a square shape.
translation.控制按钮的高度、字号和内边距。: Controls button height, font size, and padding.
translation.控制文件项的预览和下载操作。: Controls file-item preview and download actions.
translation.控制文本域外层控件尺寸。: Controls the size of the outer textarea control.
translation.控制时间范围面板显示状态。: Controls the visibility of the time-range panel.
translation.控制时间面板显示状态。: Controls the visibility of the time panel.
translation.控制是否渲染右侧独立关闭按钮；关闭按钮始终垂直居中且不挤压正文。: Controls whether a separate close button is rendered on the right; the button stays vertically centered without squeezing the body text.
translation.控制是否自动上传及是否渲染文件列表。: Controls automatic uploading and whether the file list is rendered.
translation.控制标签页视觉风格。: Controls the visual style of tabs.
translation.控制横幅模式和边框显示。: Controls banner mode and border visibility.
translation.控制每个级联列的搜索关键词及初始值；搜索只过滤当前列，不改变已选路径。: Controls each cascader column's search keyword and initial value; search filters only the current column and does not change the selected path.
translation.控制气泡内容尺寸。: Controls the size of the popover content.
translation.控制气泡内容尺寸，避免窄屏溢出。: Controls popover content size to prevent overflow on narrow screens.
translation.控制消息自动关闭的延迟；关闭按钮仍可立即关闭消息。: Controls the delay before a message closes automatically; the close button can still close it immediately.
translation.控制省略内容的行数。: Controls the number of lines in the ellipsized content.
translation.控制确认语义色和确定按钮样式。: Controls the confirmation semantic color and confirm-button style.
translation.控制级联面板显示状态。: Controls the visibility of the cascader panel.
translation.控制背景交互和碰撞时的定位策略。: Controls background interaction and the positioning strategy when collisions occur.
translation.控制范围面板显示状态。: Controls the visibility of the range panel.
translation.控制触发器高度；单选与多选保持同一尺寸。: Controls trigger height; single and multiple selection use the same size.
translation.控制详情分组默认是否使用浅色背景和圆角边框。: Controls whether detail groups use a light background and rounded border by default.
translation.控制轨道和滑块尺寸。: Controls the sizes of the track and thumb.
translation.控制输入框高度和内部间距。: Controls input height and internal spacing.
translation.控制面板显示并接收开关变化。: Controls panel visibility and receives open-state changes.
translation.控制预览 Dialog 显示状态。: Controls the visibility of the preview Dialog.
translation.提交表单时对应的原生 value。: The corresponding native value when the form is submitted.
translation.提供列表渲染数据源。: Provides the data source for list rendering.
translation.提供图片加载状态的降级渲染。: Provides fallback rendering for image loading states.
translation.提供无搜索、全列搜索和指定第四层搜索/增量懒加载三个案例；搜索只过滤当前列，第四: Provides three examples: no search, search in every column, and search/incremental lazy loading in the fourth level; search filters only the current column. The fourth level initially shows 40 items, loads more by scrolling to the bottom or clicking, and contains 600 items in total.
translation.提供独立加载指示器或覆盖在内容区域上的加载状态。: Provides a standalone loading indicator or a loading overlay on the content area.
translation.提供统一的加载指示和中文/英文文案。: Provides a consistent loading indicator and Chinese/English text.
translation.搜索与懒加载单选（600 条，滚动或点击加载）: Searchable single selection with lazy loading (600 items, scroll or click to load)
translation.搜索单选、全部选项与自定义下拉区域: Searchable single selection, all options, and a custom dropdown area
translation.搜索文本变化后的回调。: Callback after the search text changes.
translation.搜索词变化后的回调。: Callback after the search term changes.
translation.支持 disabled、受控状态、方向、碰撞避障和自定义 classNames。: Supports disabled, controlled state, direction, collision avoidance, and custom classNames.
translation.支持分隔、标签、图标、快捷键、checkbox 和 submenu。: Supports separators, labels, icons, shortcuts, checkbox, and submenu.
translation.支持受控、loading、只读和受控联动；开关本体保持纯胶囊轨道，不在内部显示文: Supports controlled state, loading, read-only mode, and linked controlled state; the switch itself keeps a plain capsule-shaped track with no internal text.
translation.支持图片、PDF、Markdown；单文件不超过 5 MB。: Supports images, PDF, and Markdown; each file must not exceed 5 MB.
translation.支持尺寸约束、懒加载、加载降级和点击预览；上传缩略图继续使用 Upload/Fi: Supports size constraints, lazy loading, loading fallback, and click-to-preview; upload thumbnails continue to use Upload/FilePreview.
translation.支持展开、收起和自定义触发器。: Supports expanding, collapsing, and custom triggers.
translation.支持当前颜色、颜色文本和常用预设色。: Supports the current color, color text, and common preset colors.
translation.支持数字徽标、圆点徽标和语义颜色。: Supports numeric badges, dot badges, and semantic colors.
translation.支持百分比、状态色和连续进度反馈。: Supports percentages, status colors, and continuous progress feedback.
translation.支持自定义头部、尾部和菜单渲染: Supports custom header, footer, and menu rendering
translation.收起菜单文本，仅保留图标栏语义。: Collapses menu text, keeping the icon-bar semantics.
translation.数字像素值或 CSS 宽度字符串: A numeric pixel value or a CSS width string
translation.数字像素或 CSS 长度: A numeric pixel value or a CSS length
translation.文件列表变化后的受控回调。: Controlled callback after the file list changes.
translation.文件进入队列前执行校验或异步预处理。: Validates files or performs async preprocessing before they enter the queue.
translation.无数据时提供明确的视觉反馈和可选操作。: Provides clear visual feedback and optional actions when there is no data.
translation.日期或起止时间禁用配置: Disabled date or start/end time configuration
translation.时间列使用 12 小时制或 24 小时制。: Uses a 12-hour or 24-hour clock in the time columns.
translation.是否显示 label 传入的进度说明；label 超出宽度时通过公共 Ellip: Controls whether to show the progress description supplied through label; when label exceeds the available width, the shared Ellipsis provides a Tooltip.
translation.是否显示回到顶部按钮；滚动距离超过 backTopThreshold 后出现。: Controls whether to show the back-to-top button; it appears after scrolling beyond backTopThreshold.
translation.是否显示当前滚动百分比；进度条始终反映真实比例。: Controls whether to show the current scroll percentage; the progress bar always reflects the actual ratio.
translation.是否显示当前颜色文本值。: Controls whether to show the current color as text.
translation.显式设置全局消息的阅读方向；组件不读取 Runtime 或 ConfigProv: Explicitly sets the reading direction of global messages; the component does not read direction from Runtime or ConfigProvider and defaults to LTR when omitted. Text, the semantic side border, and action positions follow the selected direction.
translation.显式设置提示的阅读方向；组件不读取 Runtime 或 ConfigProvid: Explicitly sets the alert reading direction; the component does not read direction from Runtime or ConfigProvider and defaults to LTR when omitted. The icon, body, actions, and close button follow the selected direction.
translation.显式设置菜单阅读方向；组件不读取 Runtime 或 ConfigProvide: Explicitly sets the menu reading direction; the component does not read direction from Runtime or ConfigProvider and defaults to LTR when omitted. Submenu hierarchy lines, arrows, and text follow the selected direction.
translation.显式设置通知卡片方向；组件不读取 Runtime 或 ConfigProvide: Explicitly sets the notification-card direction; the component does not read direction from Runtime or ConfigProvider and defaults to LTR when omitted. Notifications are placed in the inline-end stack for the selected direction.
translation.显示 default 语义的全局消息并返回实例 id；默认使用简约表面。: Shows a global message with default semantics and returns its instance id; uses a minimal surface by default.
translation.显示 error 语义的全局消息并返回实例 id；默认使用简约表面。: Shows a global message with error semantics and returns its instance id; uses a minimal surface by default.
translation.显示 info 语义的全局消息并返回实例 id；默认使用简约表面。: Shows a global message with info semantics and returns its instance id; uses a minimal surface by default.
translation.显示 primary 语义的全局消息并返回实例 id；默认使用简约表面。: Shows a global message with primary semantics and returns its instance id; uses a minimal surface by default.
translation.显示 success 语义的全局消息并返回实例 id；默认使用简约表面。: Shows a global message with success semantics and returns its instance id; uses a minimal surface by default.
translation.显示 warning 语义的全局消息并返回实例 id；默认使用简约表面。: Shows a global message with warning semantics and returns its instance id; uses a minimal surface by default.
translation.显示关闭按钮；关闭后整页刷新前保持隐藏；稳定的 Anchor id 可保证 SP: Shows a close button; after closing, the outline stays hidden until a full-page reload. A stable Anchor id keeps it hidden when navigating away and back in an SPA.
translation.显示加载状态并暂时禁止操作。: Shows a loading state and temporarily disables interaction.
translation.显示加载状态并阻止重复点击。: Shows a loading state and prevents repeated clicks.
translation.显示圆点徽标并忽略 count 展示。: Shows a dot badge and ignores count.
translation.显示在省略区域中的文本或节点。: The text or node shown in the ellipsis region.
translation.显示并处理逻辑末端垂直居中的关闭按钮（LTR 右侧、RTL 左侧）。: Shows and handles a vertically centered close button at the logical end (right in LTR, left in RTL).
translation.显示指定 type 或默认 info 的全局消息并返回实例 id。: Shows a global message with the specified type, or info by default, and returns its instance id.
translation.显示数字或自定义徽标内容。: Shows numeric or custom badge content.
translation.显示树内搜索框。: Shows the search box inside the tree.
translation.显示校验错误并切换错误样式。: Shows validation errors and switches to error styling.
translation.显示清除当前日期的操作。: Shows an action to clear the current date.
translation.显示独立拖动按钮；可用鼠标、触屏或键盘在视窗内移动整个目录，static 普通布: Shows a standalone drag button; mouse, touch, or keyboard can move the entire outline within the viewport. The normal static layout does not respond to dragging.
translation.显示移除按钮并处理点击。: Shows a remove button and handles clicks.
translation.显示跟随实际碰撞位置的箭头。: Shows an arrow that follows the actual placement after collision handling.
translation.显示输入加载状态并暂时禁用输入。: Shows an input loading state and temporarily disables input.
translation.显示页码输入并支持回车快速跳转。: Shows a page-number input and supports quick navigation with Enter.
translation.普通容器支持受边界约束的宽高调整，并通过回调同步最新尺寸。: A standard container supports bounded width and height resizing and synchronizes the latest size through a callback.
translation.替换 Box 根节点元素，同时保留 biu-ui-box 根类和传入属性。: Replaces the Box root element while preserving the biu-ui-box root class and supplied props.
translation.替换内置图标；当前实现不以空白图标占位。: Replaces the built-in icon; the current implementation does not reserve space with a blank icon.
translation.替换加载器旁的提示文案。: Replaces the text beside the loader.
translation.替换文本目标节点类型。: Replaces the target element type for text.
translation.替换省略区域的展示内容，不改变实际复制值。: Replaces the content shown in the ellipsis region without changing the actual copied value.
translation.替换默认上传传输并回报进度。: Replaces the default upload transport and reports progress.
translation.最多支持 h1 到 h5；层级通过缩进表达，当前滚动位置会高亮对应标题。: Supports h1 through h5; indentation expresses hierarchy, and the heading corresponding to the current scroll position is highlighted.
translation.最小布局容器，支持 css/sx CSS-in-JS 对象、数组和函数样式。: A minimal layout container supporting css/sx CSS-in-JS objects, arrays, and style functions.
translation.最新单值或范围值: Latest single value or range value
translation.有值时显示清除按钮并触发 onClear。: Shows a clear button when a value exists and triggers onClear.
translation.本区内容阅读进度说明: Reading progress description for this section
translation.本页手动切换方向，只传给对应案例组件实例，不读取全局方向配置。: Direction is switched manually on this page and passed only to the corresponding example component instance; the global direction configuration is not read.
translation.标准表单联动、name 隔离和禁用项。: Standard form integration, name isolation, and disabled options.
translation.标记是否还有数据及当前是否正在加载。: Indicates whether more data is available and whether loading is in progress.
translation.树节点展开、选择、多选和禁用状态。: Tree-node expansion, selection, multiple selection, and disabled states.
translation.正整数或 CSS grid-template-columns: A positive integer or CSS grid-template-columns
translation.每个目录项都是带 href 的真实链接，支持键盘聚焦、点击定位和自定义偏移。: Each outline item is a real link with an href, supporting keyboard focus, click-to-scroll, and custom offsets.
translation.每页条数。: The number of items per page.
translation.气泡中渲染的业务内容。: The business content rendered in the popover.
translation.渲染上传文件列表。: Renders the list of uploaded files.
translation.渲染单个文件项及上传状态。: Renders a single file item and its upload status.
translation.渲染卡片头部标题和说明。: Renders the card header title and description.
translation.渲染受边界约束的可调整容器。: Renders a resizable container constrained by bounds.
translation.渲染可约束尺寸的图片。: Renders an image with size constraints.
translation.渲染在分组标题前的图标。: Renders the icon before a group title.
translation.渲染对应级别的标题。: Renders a heading at the corresponding level.
translation.渲染时间线节点、内容、时间和自定义圆点。: Renders timeline nodes, content, times, and custom dots.
translation.渲染条目最右侧操作区；右侧双向模式未自定义时显示删除按钮，点击后将条目移回左侧。: Renders the action area at the far right of an item; in bidirectional mode, the right side shows a delete button when no custom action is provided. Clicking it moves the item back to the left.
translation.渲染独立或覆盖在内容上的加载指示器。: Render a standalone loading indicator or one overlaid on content.
translation.渲染详细说明；未传 description 时使用 children。: Render detailed information; use children when description is omitted.
translation.滚动到选项底部时加载更多数据。: Load more data when scrolling to the bottom of the options.
translation.滚动时固定工具或提示内容，支持指定滚动容器和状态回调。: Keep tools or helper content fixed while scrolling; supports a custom scroll container and state callback.
translation.滚动时将内容固定在视口边缘。: Fix content to the viewport edge while scrolling.
translation.点击 Alert 右侧垂直居中的关闭按钮后触发；由调用方移除或隐藏 Alert。: Called after clicking the vertically centered close button on the right of Alert; the caller removes or hides Alert.
translation.点击叶子菜单项后触发；目录项只切换展开状态，不触发选择回调。: Called after clicking a leaf menu item; directory items only toggle expansion and do not invoke the selection callback.
translation.点击打开预览，并控制图片适配方式。: Click to open the preview and control how the image fits.
translation.点击某个 Tab 的关闭按钮后触发；调用方负责从 items 中移除该 key。: Called after clicking a Tab close button; the caller removes the corresponding key from items.
translation.点击气泡确认的取消按钮后触发；确认流程不会被启动。: Called after clicking the popover confirmation cancel button; the confirmation process does not start.
translation.点击清除按钮后的回调。: Callback after clicking the clear button.
translation.点击确定后的同步或异步处理；返回 false 不关闭。: Synchronous or asynchronous handling after confirmation; returning false keeps it open.
translation.点击菜单项后的选择回调。: Selection callback after clicking a menu item.
translation.独立 Spin 时覆盖当前视口。: Cover the current viewport when Spin is standalone.
translation.用于展示详情字段说明。: Used to display detail field descriptions.
translation.用于展示详情记录的示例名称。: Sample name for the detail record.
translation.用于承载一组相关内容，保持标题、内容和间距一致。: Group related content with consistent titles, content, and spacing.
translation.用于表达轻量状态，支持语义颜色和自定义内容。: Represent lightweight status with semantic colors and custom content.
translation.用于连续数值、范围和分档数值选择；支持键盘、点击轨道、刻度、范围双滑块、垂直方向: Select continuous values, ranges, or stepped values; supports keyboard input, track clicks, marks, dual range thumbs, vertical orientation, and value Tooltip.
translation.用户点击回顶按钮后触发，可用于埋点或同步外部状态。: Called after clicking the back-to-top button; useful for analytics or synchronizing external state.
translation.监听指定滚动容器并通知固定状态。: Listen to the specified scroll container and report the fixed state.
translation.确认/取消、异步 loading、danger 类型、description 和: Confirmation/cancellation, asynchronous loading, danger type, description, and disabled state.
translation.确认气泡的主标题。: Main title of the confirmation popover.
translation.禁止打开或修改日期。: Prevent opening or changing the date.
translation.禁止打开或修改日期范围。: Prevent opening or changing the date range.
translation.禁止打开或修改时间。: Prevent opening or changing the time.
translation.禁止打开或修改时间范围。: Prevent opening or changing the time range.
translation.禁用交互并按区域覆写样式。: Disable interaction and override styles by area.
translation.禁用单选框和标签点击。: Disable radio button and label clicks.
translation.禁用拖动、点击和键盘操作。: Disable dragging, clicking, and keyboard interaction.
translation.禁用文本域和清除操作。: Disable the textarea and clear action.

translation.覆写确认或取消按钮属性和样式。: Override confirm or cancel button props and styles.

translation.覆盖 onlyIcon 按钮的 Tooltip 文案；普通按钮不渲染 Toolt: Override the Tooltip text of an onlyIcon button; regular buttons do not render Tooltip.
translation.覆盖图标的宽度、高度和字号。: Override icon width, height, and font size.
translation.覆盖左侧快捷日期列表。: Override the shortcut date list on the left.
translation.覆盖当前分组的栅格列数。: Override the grid column count of the current group.
translation.覆盖提示背景色，同时箭头同步使用该颜色。: Override the tooltip background color; the arrow uses the same color.

translation.覆盖预览标题和下载文件名。: Override the preview title and download filename.

translation.设置 Anchor 根节点 id；closable 用它在 SPA 切页再返回时: Set the Anchor root id; closable uses it to identify and retain the closed state when returning after SPA navigation.
translation.设置 Drawer 从哪个视口边缘滑入。: Set which viewport edge Drawer slides in from.
translation.设置 Stack 主轴上的分布方式；实际值透传到 CSS justify-con: Set item distribution along the Stack main axis; the value is passed to CSS justify-content.
translation.设置两侧触发器占位文案。: Set placeholder text for both triggers.
translation.设置优先方向和对齐方式；空间不足时自动调整。: Set the preferred direction and alignment; adjust automatically when space is insufficient.
translation.设置优先方向；Radix 根据空间自动翻转和避障。: Set the preferred direction; Radix automatically flips and avoids collisions based on available space.
translation.设置侧向宽度或上下方向高度。: Set the side width or the height for top/bottom placement.
translation.设置关闭按钮等内置文案。: Set built-in text such as the close button label.
translation.设置列表边框及条目密度。: Set the list border and item density.
translation.设置单行或多行省略行数。: Set the line count for single-line or multiline ellipsis.
translation.设置原生 button 的提交语义；不改变按钮语义色。: Set native button submission semantics without changing the button's semantic color.
translation.设置原生 input 的自动填充策略。: Set the native input autofill strategy.
translation.设置可折叠标题节点的箭头位置；start/end 随 LTR/RTL 方向变化，: Set the arrow position of collapsible heading nodes; start/end follow LTR/RTL direction, while left/right specify physical sides.
translation.设置回到顶部时的滚动动画行为。: Set scroll animation behavior for returning to the top.
translation.设置图片、PDF、视频或文本预览高度。: Set the preview height for images, PDFs, videos, or text.
translation.设置子项主轴方向。: Set the main-axis direction of children.
translation.设置子项排列方向。: Set the arrangement direction of children.
translation.设置所有分组的默认栅格列数，分组可单独覆盖。: Set the default grid column count for all groups; individual groups can override it.
translation.设置拖动、键盘和点击轨道时的步进，并按十进制精度吸附。: Set the step for dragging, keyboard input, and track clicks, with snapping based on decimal precision.
translation.设置按钮组子项之间的统一间距。: Set consistent spacing between button group items.
translation.设置提示语义色、边框和内置图标。: Set the alert's semantic color, border, and built-in icon.
translation.设置文本颜色；支持主题语义色和自定义颜色。: Set text color; supports theme semantic colors and custom colors.
translation.设置滑块可选范围的最大值。: Set the maximum selectable slider value.
translation.设置滑块可选范围的最小值。: Set the minimum selectable slider value.
translation.设置滑块整体透明度，0 为完全透明，1 为完全不透明。: Set the overall slider opacity; 0 is fully transparent and 1 is fully opaque.
translation.设置相邻面包屑之间的分隔符。: Set the separator between adjacent breadcrumb items.
translation.设置移除按钮等文案。: Set text such as the remove button label.
translation.设置纵向时间线的内容布局模式。: Set the content layout mode of a vertical timeline.
translation.设置网格列数或列模板。: Set the grid column count or column template.

translation.默认开启 header 拖动；交互控件不启动拖动，Dialog 始终限制在视口范: Dragging by the header is enabled by default; interactive controls do not initiate dragging, Dialog stays within the viewport, and fullscreen mode ignores dragging.
translation.默认是轻量简约样式；复杂样式使用 complex=true。四个案例覆盖单行、多: The default is a lightweight simple style; use complex=true for the complex style. Four examples cover single lines, multiple lines, and different semantic colors. The close button always occupies the logical end exclusively (right in LTR, left in RTL).
translation.显式设置 Table / ProTable 阅读方向；不会读取门户、Runtim: Explicitly sets the Table / ProTable reading direction; it does not read direction from the Portal, Runtime, or ConfigProvider and defaults to LTR. Regular-column drag boundaries and the default text start mirror with dir.
translation.只为显式开启的叶子列显示手柄；所有列的手柄统一在表头悬停或手柄聚焦时显示，触屏设: Handles appear only for explicitly enabled leaf columns and become visible when the header is hovered or a handle is focused; touch devices use a low-contrast hint. Regular and dynamic column handles sit at the logical end (right in LTR, left in RTL). Dragging a dynamic column is offset by the previous regular column. For other columns, the dynamic column absorbs the change first; after it reaches a limit, the previous regular column absorbs the remainder. A fixed column adjusts through its inner edge facing the regular columns.
translation.按稳定请求 Key 取消前请求；FormData、Blob、ArrayBuffe: Cancel earlier requests with a stable request key; FormData, Blob, ArrayBuffer and buffer views deduplicate only the same instance, while distinct upload instances may run concurrently.
translation.按稳定键顺序序列化普通数据；二进制上传去重身份由客户端内部维护。: Serialize ordinary data with stable key ordering; the client manages binary upload identity internally.
